title: Rollout then Recycle: 3,718 Labelled Real-Robot Episodes from Benchmarking 7 Policies on 12 Tasks
summary: We release all 3,718 episodes from the ArmnetBench v0.1 evaluation (arXiv:2607.24481), which contains 600 teleoperated demonstrations and 3,118 rollouts of seven imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies on 12 tabletop tasks, recorded on low-cost SO-101 arms; 73% of the rollouts are failures. Every policy for a task was trained or fine-tuned on the same 50 demonstrations and rolled out on the same cell, so the corpus contains many policies' failures on shared tasks. An operator labelled every rollout successful, suboptimal or failure. Each episode has three camera views, joint states and actions and is available on the Hugging Face Hub in LeRobot v3.0 and a reward-model format. This note documents how the episodes were collected and the limitations that could affect their use.
tldr: This paper releases a large dataset of 3,718 real-robot episodes from benchmarking seven imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies across twelve tabletop tasks, including many failure rollouts with detailed labels, to support the robotics community in learning from failures and improving policy generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文发布了一个包含3,718个真实机器人回合的大型数据集，来自对七种模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作策略在十二项桌面任务上的基准测试，其中包含大量标记的失败回合，以支持机器人社区从失败中学习并提高策略泛化能力。
summary_zh: 我们发布了ArmnetBench v0.1评估（arXiv:2607.24481）中全部3，718个片段，其中包含600个远程操作演示，以及7种模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作策略在12项桌面任务上的3，118次 rollout，这些数据均通过低成本SO-101机械臂记录；其中73%的rollout为失败案例。每项任务的策略均在相同的50个演示上训练或微调，并在同一单元上进行rollout，因此该语料库包含多种策略在共享任务上的失败实例。操作员将每个rollout标记为成功、次优或失败。每个片段包含三个摄像头视角、关节状态和动作，以LeRobot v3.0及奖励模型格式发布于Hugging Face Hub。本文档说明了这些片段的收集方式，以及可能影响其使用的局限性。

title: ReContact: Reconstruct and Retarget Human Contacts from Video for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation
summary: Contact transitions allow humanoid robots to redistribute object support across the whole body, enabling manipulation beyond hand-only grasps. Human videos provide a scalable source of such transitions for robots to learn from. However, body occlusion disrupts object pose tracking and corrupts retargeted motion. Moreover, accurately reproducing the object trajectory does not ensure that the robot applies stabilizing forces at the intended contacts, risking slips or drops in later phases. To address these challenges, we propose ReContact, which reconstructs and retargets human-object interactions through an object-centric contact plan. The plan specifies contact phases, contact pairs, anchors, pressing directions, and sticking or sliding modes. Contact priors stabilize object pose reconstruction through occlusion. A residual policy over a frozen whole-body tracker is rewarded for making contact at planned anchors with forces aligned to the specified directions. In simulation, on a thigh-supported regrasp task, ReContact achieves the planned two-palm bottom hold in 83.5 of episodes over three training seeds, versus 0.16% for the best adapted baseline. One policy trained on 247 references re-solved for new placements raises in-workspace tube-transfer success from 20.4% (source reference only) to 97.8%. On a real Unitree G1, policies execute seven contact-rich manipulation and two loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr: ReContact reconstructs and retargets human-object contacts from video via an object-centric contact plan, enabling contact-rich humanoid manipulation with a residual policy over a frozen whole-body tracker.
tldr_zh: ReContact 通过以物体为中心的接触计划从视频中重建并重定向人-物交互，在冻结全身跟踪器上训练残差策略，实现接触丰富的人形机器人操作。
summary_zh: 接触转换使人形机器人能够在全身范围内重新分配物体支撑，从而实现超越仅靠手部抓取的操作。人类视频为机器人学习此类转换提供了可扩展的来源。然而，身体遮挡会破坏物体姿态跟踪并导致重定向运动失真。此外，准确复现物体轨迹并不能确保机器人在预期接触点施加稳定力，从而在后续阶段存在滑动或掉落的风险。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReContact，它通过以物体为中心的接触规划来重建和重定向人-物交互。该规划指定了接触阶段、接触对、锚点、按压方向以及粘附或滑动模式。接触先验通过遮挡稳定物体姿态重建。在冻结的全身跟踪器之上，一个残差策略被奖励在规划锚点处按照指定方向施加力进行接触。在仿真中，对于大腿支撑的重新抓取任务，ReContact在三个训练种子上的83.5个回合中实现了规划的双掌底部保持，而最佳适配基线仅为0.16%。一个在247个参考上训练的策略重新求解新放置后，将工作空间内管件传递成功率从20.4%（仅源参考）提升至97.8%。在真实的Unitree G1上，策略执行了七项接触密集型操作任务和两项移动操作任务。

title: ReGATE: Recurrent Gated Visual Fusion for Reactive Humanoid-Object Interaction
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating object acquisition, transport, and release from onboard sensing while responding to user commands and incomplete visual observations. We present ReGATE, a whole-body controller that combines egocentric depth, proprioception, and online locomotion and contact commands. Built on a teacher-student framework, ReGATE integrates interaction-state estimation through a recurrent adapter that predicts object geometry and physical contact without an external object-pose estimator. Head-wise and global gates regulate visual updates to a proprioceptive pathway. A visual-grounding and corruption curriculum trains the adapter, while phase-aware initialization increases coverage of brief contact transitions. In simulation, ReGATE achieves 85.2% success across 330 static-object acquisition trials, compared with 48.5% for VisualMimic under the same protocol, and 85.9% across 440 moving-object acquisition trials. Deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates commanded grasp-transport-release sequences and acquisition of laterally displaced boxes. A qualitative hardware experiment further demonstrates successful box acquisition when the camera is occluded after an initial observation and before the contact command. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to extend recurrent gated fusion of onboard depth and proprioception from perceptive locomotion to humanoid loco-manipulation under interrupted visual sensing.
tldr: ReGATE is a whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation controller that uses recurrent gated fusion of egocentric depth and proprioception with a teacher-student framework to achieve object acquisition, transport, and release under incomplete visual observations, outperforming VisualMimic and deployed on a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: ReGATE 是一种全身人形机器人移动操作控制器，通过递归门控融合第一视角深度和本体感知，采用教师-学生框架，在视觉观测不完整的情况下实现物体抓取、运输和释放，性能超越 VisualMimic 并部署于 Unitree G1。
summary_zh: 人形移动操作需要在响应用户指令和不完整视觉观测的同时，协调从机载传感实现物体的获取、运输和释放。我们提出了ReGATE，一种全身控制器，它融合了自我中心深度、本体感觉以及在线移动和接触指令。ReGATE基于教师-学生框架，通过一个递归适配器集成交互状态估计，无需外部物体姿态估计器即可预测物体几何形状和物理接触。头部门控和全局门控调控视觉更新对本体感觉通路的输入。视觉锚定与损坏课程训练适配器，而相位感知初始化提高了短暂接触过渡的覆盖率。在仿真中，ReGATE在330次静态物体获取试验中达到85.2%的成功率，而相同协议下VisualMimic为48.5%；在440次移动物体获取试验中成功率为85.9%。在Unitree G1上的部署展示了指令化的抓取-运输-释放序列以及对横向偏移箱体的获取。一项定性硬件实验进一步展示了在初始观测之后、接触指令之前相机被遮挡时仍能成功获取箱体。据我们所知，这是首个将机载深度和本体感觉的递归门控融合从感知运动扩展到视觉传感中断下的人形移动操作的工作。

title: Beyond Policy Patches: Distilling RL Specialists into Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can handle noncritical stages of long-horizon manipulation yet fail during short precision-critical phases. Lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) specialists can address these failures without directly applying RL to the full VLA, but retain auxiliary controllers and switching mechanisms at deployment. We study how to transfer their capabilities into a single flow-matching VLA. Direct imitation of specialist rollouts can reproduce action jitter and leave the VLA unprepared for states encountered during its own execution. We introduce REPAIR, a value-guided distillation framework that combines offline initialization with on-policy refinement. At each critical-phase observation, REPAIR queries the corresponding specialist for multiple action candidates and weights them using its critic to construct a supervision distribution. A shared weighted flow-matching objective trains the VLA first on observations from specialist-assisted rollouts, then on observations collected through its own execution. Specialists provide supervision without taking control during on-policy collection and are removed at deployment. Across six real-robot tasks with 30 evaluation trials per task, REPAIR achieves 100% success on all six tasks, with lower mean end-effector jerk than specialist-assisted execution on every task.
tldr: REPAIR is a value-guided distillation framework that transfers RL specialists into a single flow-matching VLA policy via weighted action candidates and on-policy refinement, achieving 100% success on six real-robot precision-critical manipulation tasks while removing specialists at deployment.
tldr_zh: REPAIR 提出一种价值引导蒸馏框架，将轻量级 RL 专家策略迁移到单一 flow-matching VLA 策略中，通过专家动作候选加权监督与在策略精炼，在六项真实机器人精密操作任务上达到 100% 成功率，并在部署时移除专家。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够处理长程操作任务中的非关键阶段，但在短暂的高精度关键阶段中往往失效。轻量级强化学习（RL）专家策略可以在不将RL直接应用于完整VLA的情况下解决这些失败问题，但在部署时仍需保留辅助控制器和切换机制。我们研究如何将其能力迁移到单一的流匹配VLA中。直接模仿专家策略的 rollout 会复制动作抖动，并使VLA对其自身执行过程中遇到的状态缺乏准备。我们提出REPAIR，一种价值引导的蒸馏框架，将离线初始化与在线策略细化相结合。在每个关键阶段观测中，REPAIR向相应专家策略查询多个候选动作，并利用其评论家网络为这些动作赋予权重，从而构建监督分布。一个共享的加权流匹配目标首先在专家辅助rollout的观测上训练VLA，随后在其自身执行收集的观测上继续训练。在在线策略数据收集过程中，专家策略仅提供监督而不接管控制，并在部署时完全移除。在六个真实机器人任务、每项任务30次评估试验中，REPAIR在所有六个任务上均达到100%的成功率，并且在每项任务上的平均末端执行器加加速度均低于专家辅助执行。

title: HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. Most existing VLA architectures operate under a Markovian assumption, mapping only the current observation to an action, which leads to failure in non-Markovian environments. Inspired by the human 'inner monologue', we propose Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory (HeLM), a hierarchical VLA framework that maintains task-relevant history in explicit language through factorized event detection and event-triggered memory updates. We evaluate HeLM across 10 non-Markovian real-world tasks with 56 variants, including five newly formulated inter-episode tasks that require persistent context across task boundaries. HeLM improves intra-episode success by 12.8 percentage points over the strongest baseline and achieves 78% subtask success on compositional generalization tasks, while using up to 4.5x less memory and running 2.5x faster than the keyframe baseline at long horizons.
tldr: HeLM is a hierarchical VLA framework that uses explicit language memory via factorized event detection and event-triggered updates to handle non-Markovian manipulation tasks, improving success and efficiency on real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: HeLM是一种分层VLA框架，通过分解事件检测和事件触发更新来维护显式语言记忆，以解决非马尔可夫操作任务，在真实世界基准上提升了成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 近期在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型方面的进展已实现精细操作能力，然而，执行需要工作记忆的任务仍是一项关键挑战。大多数现有VLA架构基于马尔可夫假设运行，仅将当前观测映射到动作，导致在非马尔可夫环境中失败。受人类“内心独白”的启发，我们提出层次化显式语言记忆（HeLM），一种层次化VLA框架，通过分解事件检测和事件触发记忆更新，在显式语言中维护任务相关历史。我们在包含56种变体的10项非马尔可夫真实世界任务中评估HeLM，其中包括五项新制定的跨情节任务，这些任务需要跨任务边界的持续上下文。HeLM在情节内成功率上比最强基线提高12.8个百分点，并在组合泛化任务中实现78%的子任务成功率，同时在长时程中使用的内存比关键帧基线少达4.5倍，运行速度快2.5倍。

title: INTERACT: Learning Interaction-Aware World Dynamics from Driving Videos for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safe autonomous driving requires more than recognizing the current scene: the ego vehicle must anticipate how surrounding traffic participants will evolve under its own motion. However, existing end-to-end driving models typically encode scenes into dense visual or BEV features, leaving object-level interactions implicit. We propose (INTERACT INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning), a three-stage framework that learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and transfers it to trajectory planning. INTERACT first learns recurrent slots that group dense visual features into temporally structured scene-entity representations without object annotations. It then infers latent ego actions from slot context and video transitions, and uses them to condition future slot prediction, capturing how ego motion and surrounding entities co-evolve. Finally, the learned slots, latent actions, and future slot predictions are distilled into a trajectory planner to guide trajectory generation and selection. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes validate the effectiveness of INTERACT. In particular, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM, with improvements in safety-critical collision metrics.
tldr: INTERACT learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and distills it into a trajectory planner, achieving state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM with improved collision metrics.
tldr_zh: INTERACT 从无标注驾驶视频中学习基于槽位的对象中心世界模型，并将其蒸馏到轨迹规划器中，在 NAVSIM 上取得了最先进的性能，并改善了碰撞指标。
summary_zh: 安全的自动驾驶不仅需要识别当前场景，还要求自车预测周围交通参与者在其自身运动下将如何演变。然而，现有的端到端驾驶模型通常将场景编码为密集的视觉或BEV特征，使物体级交互保持隐式。我们提出INTERACT（INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning，交互感知动作条件轨迹学习），这是一个三阶段框架，从无标注驾驶视频中学习基于槽的以物体为中心的世界模型，并将其迁移至轨迹规划。INTERACT首先学习循环槽，在没有物体标注的情况下将密集视觉特征分组为时序结构化的场景实体表示。随后，它从槽上下文和视频转移中推断潜在自车动作，并以此作为未来槽预测的条件，捕捉自车运动与周围实体如何共同演变。最后，将学习到的槽、潜在动作和未来槽预测蒸馏到轨迹规划器中，以指导轨迹生成与选择。在NAVSIM和nuScenes上的大量实验验证了INTERACT的有效性。特别是在NAVSIM上达到了最先进性能，并在安全关键碰撞指标上取得改进。

title: When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning
summary: Conventional robot arms can be extremely heavy compared with the everyday objects they manipulate, creating a significant inertia mismatch at contact. Even a small accidental bump from a heavy arm can knock a light object out of place. Modern learning methods have nevertheless demonstrated a wide range of successful manipulation behaviors on these platforms, suggesting that even extreme inertia mismatch can be overcome with sufficient data. However, it remains unclear whether high inertia imposes a hidden cost on learning, potentially worsening scaling with data or lowering the performance ceiling of modern robot learning methods. We investigate this question through controlled simulation experiments that vary robot and object masses. We find that reinforcement learning succeeds across a broad range of mass combinations, while behavior cloning learns more reliable policies when a lighter robot manipulates a heavier object, and more data narrows the resulting gap without closing it. Behavior cloning likewise degrades on a simulated robot arm as its motors reflect more inertia through their gearing, even though its weight stays the same. Finally, because new hardware is rarely an option, we explore ways to lower contact inertia on the arm one already has, either by choosing a lower-inertia workspace before collecting data or by steering the demonstrator toward lower-inertia solutions of the task. In both simulated cases, the lower-inertia demonstrations are imitated more reliably. Project website: https://younghyopark.me/inertia-mismatch/
tldr: This paper investigates how inertia mismatch between heavy robot arms and light objects affects robot policy learning, finding that behavior cloning degrades with higher inertia while reinforcement learning is more robust, and proposes strategies to lower contact inertia for better imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了重机械臂与轻物体之间的惯性不匹配如何影响机器人策略学习，发现行为克隆在高惯性下性能下降而强化学习更鲁棒，并提出了降低接触惯性以改进模仿学习的策略。
summary_zh: 传统机器人手臂与它们操作的日常物体相比，可能显得极为沉重，导致在接触时产生显著的惯性失配。即使是重型手臂轻微的意外碰撞，也足以将轻巧的物体撞离原位。尽管如此，现代学习方法已在这些平台上展示了广泛且成功的操作行为，表明即便是极端的惯性失配，也能通过充足的数据加以克服。然而，高惯性是否会给学习过程带来隐性成本，可能导致数据扩展性变差或降低现代机器人学习方法的性能上限，这一问题尚不明朗。我们通过控制变量模拟实验，调整机器人与物体的质量，对此进行了探究。研究发现，强化学习在广泛的质量组合中均能成功，而行为克隆在较轻机器人操作较重物体时学习到的策略更为可靠，增加数据量虽能缩小这一差距，却无法完全弥合。同样地，在模拟机器人手臂中，当电机通过传动系统反映出更大惯量时，即便手臂重量不变，行为克隆的性能也会下降。最后，鉴于更换新硬件往往不切实际，我们探索了如何降低现有手臂的接触惯量，方法包括在数据收集前选择低惯量的工作空间，或是引导演示者采用任务中惯性更小的解决方案。在这两种模拟情形下，低惯量的演示均获得了更可靠的模仿。项目网站：https://younghyopark.me/inertia-mismatch/

title: SNAP: Semantic Navigation Among Pedestrians
summary: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policy that jointly reasons about semantic terrain and dynamic obstacles from a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map, without relying on explicit human-state estimation. Our policy outperforms established crowd-navigation and semantic-aware baselines and transfers zero-shot to a legged robot, demonstrating socially compliant navigation in highly dynamic real-world scenarios.
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based navigation policy that uses a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map to jointly reason about terrain and dynamic obstacles for socially compliant crowd avoidance, demonstrating zero-shot transfer to a legged robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的导航策略，利用单张语义标注鸟瞰图（BEV）地图联合推理地形与动态障碍物，实现社会合规的人群避让，并零样本迁移到腿式机器人。
summary_zh: 在拥挤的城市环境中导航要求机器人既能避开行人，又能遵守社会规范，例如保持在人行道上。现有方法通常将人群避让或语义路径规划分开处理。我们提出了一种强化学习（RL）导航策略，该策略仅从单张带有语义标注的鸟瞰图（BEV）地图中，联合推理语义地形与动态障碍物，而不依赖显式的人类状态估计。我们的策略优于已有的人群导航和语义感知基线，并可零样本迁移至腿式机器人，展示了在高动态真实场景中符合社会规范的导航能力。

title: ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires fine-grained control and complex physical interactions with the environment, posing significant challenges for robot policy learning. Vision-only policies struggle with such tasks, as contact states and interaction forces are difficult to infer from visual observations alone. Existing methods mitigate this issue by incorporating force or tactile sensing. However, they often treat these signals as auxiliary observations without fully exploiting their role in modeling future interaction dynamics. To address this, we propose ForceLDM, a force-aware latent dynamics model that learns future contact and motion dynamics to guide action generation. Rather than directly predicting future observations, which can entangle task-relevant dynamics with irrelevant sensory details, ForceLDM learns a compact representation of future dynamics through knowledge distillation. Specifically, a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow signals extracts future dynamic features, which are then distilled into a student network trained only on current observations. This enables the student model to reason about upcoming contacts and physical dynamics without relying on future sensory inputs at deployment. To improve robustness and generalization, we further introduce a curriculum-based progressive noise injection strategy to mitigate over-reliance on future features. Experiments on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate that ForceLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, generalizes effectively to novel objects, and remains robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code are available at https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/.
tldr: ForceLDM is a force-aware latent dynamics model that distills privileged future force/torque and optical flow features into a student policy to improve contact-rich manipulation from current observations, showing strong real-world results.
tldr_zh: ForceLDM 是一种力感知潜在动力学模型，通过将特权未来力/力矩和光流特征蒸馏到学生策略中，仅利用当前观测即可改进接触丰富的操作任务，并在真实世界中取得了优异效果。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务要求精细的控制以及与环境的复杂物理交互，给机器人策略学习带来了显著挑战。仅依赖视觉的策略在此类任务中表现不佳，因为接触状态和交互力难以仅从视觉观察中准确推断。现有方法通过引入力或触觉感知来缓解这一问题，但往往将这些信号视为辅助观测，未能充分利用其在建模未来交互动态中的作用。为此，我们提出了ForceLDM，一种力感知的潜在动力学模型，通过学习未来的接触和运动动态来指导动作生成。ForceLDM不直接预测未来观测（这容易将任务相关动态与无关的感官细节纠缠在一起），而是通过知识蒸馏学习未来动态的紧凑表示。具体而言，一个具备特权未来力/力矩和光流信号的教师网络提取未来动态特征，并将其蒸馏至仅基于当前观测训练的学生网络中。这使得学生模型在部署时无需依赖未来的感官输入即可推理即将发生的接触和物理动态。为提升鲁棒性和泛化能力，我们进一步引入了基于课程学习的渐进噪声注入策略，以缓解对未来特征的过度依赖。在五个真实世界接触丰富的操作任务上的实验表明，ForceLDM优于最先进的基线方法，能够有效泛化至新物体，并对环境扰动保持鲁棒性。项目页面和代码见 https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/。

title: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.
tldr: VerifLM converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for robotic manipulation by using a VLM to generate sampling constraints and validation programs, then selecting the best candidate via parallel-world physics simulation.
tldr_zh: VerifLM 将图像编辑后的目标配置转换为经过物理验证的 6-DoF 物体位姿用于机器人操作，利用视觉语言模型生成采样约束和验证程序，并通过平行世界物理仿真选择最佳候选位姿。
summary_zh: 许多操作目标更易于可视化，而非通过显式几何约束以数值方式指定。我们提出了VerifLM，一个将图像编辑后的目标配置转换为经过物理验证的6自由度物体位姿以用于规划的框架。利用编辑后的图像，VerifLM恢复主动物体与被动物体之间的初始相对位姿，然后提示视觉语言模型生成轴向采样约束和任务特定的验证程序。候选位姿在物理模拟器中进行评估，VLM选择与任务最一致的保留候选位姿。为了在无需预定义物体网格或物理参数的情况下运行，VerifLM从RGB-D观测中重建度量物体几何，并构建多个具有不同物理和几何参数的假设仿真。并行世界验证在几何-物理变化下评估候选位姿，并根据满足验证程序的世界数量对其进行排序。我们在九个操作任务上评估了VerifLM。VerifLM在九个任务中的八个上取得了最高的任务成功率，在需要精确方向和接触关系的目标上性能提升最大。

title: FineCraft: Enhancing VLA Models for Fine-Grained Manipulation
summary: Fine-grained manipulation couples instruction grounding, local visual precision, and sustained execution. We present FineCraft, a framework that adapts pretrained models for fine-grained manipulation in the MetaFine Challenge. A task-routed mixture of policies selects independently adapted DINOv2-DiT or pretrained $π_{0.5}$ policies through a common observation-action interface. Local visual features help identify the instructed object parts, demonstrations and expert continuations teach the required actions, and new observations guide replanning during execution. FineCraft ranks fourth with an overall score of $0.878$, exceeding the published reference on all five tasks. Official results and local diagnostics characterize performance across visual perturbations, instruction changes, and multi-stage manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/eqcy/FineCraft
tldr: FineCraft adapts pretrained VLA models for fine-grained manipulation by combining a task-routed mixture of DINOv2-DiT and π0.5 policies with local visual features and replanning, achieving strong results in the MetaFine Challenge.
tldr_zh: FineCraft通过结合DINOv2-DiT和π0.5策略的任务路由混合以及局部视觉特征和重规划，适配预训练VLA模型以进行细粒度操作，在MetaFine挑战中取得了优异成绩。
summary_zh: 细粒度操作融合了指令理解、局部视觉精度与持续执行能力。我们提出了FineCraft框架，该框架将预训练模型适配到MetaFine挑战中的细粒度操作任务中。通过一种任务路由的混合策略机制，经由统一观测-动作接口，选择独立适配的DINOv2-DiT策略或预训练的$π_{0.5}$策略。局部视觉特征有助于识别被指令指定的物体部位，演示与专家连续性数据用于教授所需动作，而新的观测则指导执行过程中的重新规划。FineCraft以总分0.878排名第四，在所有五个任务上均超过了已发表的参考结果。官方结果与局部诊断分析揭示了在视觉扰动、指令变化和多阶段操作情况下的性能表现。代码已开源，见https://github.com/eqcy/FineCraft。

title: VLALagBench: Understanding When and Why VLA Inference Latency Matters
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward general-purpose robot manipulation. While inference latency can affect task success in a constantly evolving physical world, the relationship between latency and task success rate remains poorly understood. In this paper, we introduce VLALagBench, a comprehensive benchmark for studying VLA inference latency sensitivity across task types, object speeds, execution modes (synchronous and asynchronous), and VLA policies. Using VLALagBench, we find that even a modest inference latency of 100 ms can nearly halve task success on moving targets, with sensitivity varying substantially across tasks and policies. These differences reflect task-specific requirements for precision and continuous motion. By overlapping inference with action execution, asynchronous execution can recover some of the lost success at the cost of more frequent inference requests. Building on these findings, we develop an empirical model that predicts task success from limited calibration data, achieving root-mean-square prediction errors of only 5.7-7.8% across various VLA policies. Given an inference system's latency and per-robot throughput, these predictions guide the selection of system-specific VLA algorithm configurations to maximize task success. We believe VLALagBench and these findings provide a solid foundation for future robotics algorithm-system co-design.
tldr: VLALagBench is a benchmark and empirical model for quantifying how VLA inference latency impacts robot manipulation success across tasks, object speeds, and execution modes, guiding system-level algorithm configuration.
tldr_zh: VLALagBench 是一个基准和实证模型，用于量化 VLA 推理延迟对机器人操作成功率的影响，并指导系统级算法配置。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为实现通用机器人操作提供了一条极具前景的路径。尽管推理延迟会影响不断变化的物理世界中的任务成功率，但延迟与任务成功率之间的关系仍未得到充分理解。本文介绍了VLALagBench，这是一个综合性基准测试，用于研究VLA推理延迟在任务类型、物体速度、执行模式（同步与异步）以及VLA策略方面的敏感性。利用VLALagBench，我们发现即使仅100毫秒的推理延迟，也能使移动目标上的任务成功率几乎减半，且敏感性因任务和策略的不同而存在显著差异。这些差异反映了任务对精度和连续运动的具体要求。通过将推理与动作执行重叠，异步执行可以恢复部分损失的成功率，但代价是更频繁的推理请求。基于这些发现，我们开发了一个经验模型，能够从有限的校准数据中预测任务成功率，在各种VLA策略上实现了仅5.7%至7.8%的均方根预测误差。给定推理系统的延迟和每机器人吞吐量，这些预测可指导选择特定于系统的VLA算法配置，以最大化任务成功率。我们相信VLALagBench及其发现为未来机器人算法与系统的协同设计奠定了坚实基础。

title: PlanContext: Benchmarking In-Context Driving Decision-Making
summary: Real-world driving requires context-aware decision-making. Existing end-to-end driving benchmarks primarily assess trajectory quality through safety, compliance, comfort, and driving progress, leaving context-dependent decision-making insufficiently characterized. To fill this gap, we present PlanContext, a benchmark for evaluating in-context driving decision-making. PlanContext constructs paired evaluations by varying high-level driving intentions while keeping the observed scene fixed, enabling a natural and controllable assessment of context-dependent decision-making. We further define six representative driving contexts and jointly evaluate contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety with class-balanced metrics. Experiments on 9,561 scene-condition instances from NAVSIM and 23 public end-to-end driving models show that high conventional driving-quality scores do not consistently correspond to strong route-level in-context driving decision-making. Further analysis shows that model behavior varies with decision timing, road structure, and traffic interaction depending on the decision required by the current context. Our results highlight in-context driving decision-making as an important complementary dimension for evaluating end-to-end driving systems.
tldr: PlanContext is a benchmark that evaluates in-context driving decision-making by pairing scenes under varying high-level intentions, revealing that conventional trajectory quality metrics do not fully capture context-dependent decisions.
tldr_zh: PlanContext 是一个通过在相同场景下变化高层驾驶意图来配对评估上下文驾驶决策的基准，发现传统轨迹质量指标无法充分反映上下文相关的决策能力。
summary_zh: 现实世界驾驶需要具备情境感知能力的决策。现有的端到端驾驶基准主要从安全性、合规性、舒适性和行驶进度等方面评估轨迹质量，但对依赖情境的决策能力刻画不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了PlanContext，一个用于评估情境化驾驶决策的基准。PlanContext通过改变高层驾驶意图而保持观测场景不变来构建配对评估，从而实现对依赖情境的决策进行自然且可控的评估。我们进一步定义了六种代表性驾驶情境，并使用类别平衡指标联合评估情境决策正确性、道路合规性和动态安全性。在NAVSIM的9，561个场景条件实例以及23个公开端到端驾驶模型上的实验表明，较高的传统驾驶质量得分并不总是对应较强的路线级情境化驾驶决策能力。进一步分析表明，模型行为会随决策时机、道路结构和交通交互而变化，具体取决于当前情境所需的决策。我们的结果凸显了情境化驾驶决策作为评估端到端驾驶系统的重要补充维度。

title: PointPilot: Unified Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric 3D Point Flow Prediction
summary: Generalization remains a central challenge in robotics, calling for policies that address domain variations from multiple dimensions such as diverse embodiments, camera poses, and/or scene layouts. In order to approach this problem, we introduce PointPilot, a task-focused and 3D aligned manipulation framework built on a 3D space point-flow prediction. Rather than modeling the global scene, PointPilot only represents task-focused objects (robot grippers treated as objects), avoiding the prediction of potentially redundant scene parts unrelated to the manipulation tasks. Moreover, PointPilot aligns 3D spatial representation in one unified coordinate and supports closed-loop and fully automatic action execution across different manipulation modes from object point flow without a separately trained action expert, while existing works typically need an extra action head or are (semi-)automatic and single-arm mode specific. Given sensor observations and language instructions, our model jointly learns subtask planning, task-relevant object grounding, and 3D point flow prediction in an end-to-end way. By processing heterogeneous data in a shared 3D point flow space, PointPilot is able to absorb demonstrations from different embodiments. Extensive simulative and real world experiments validate our method. Notably, we demonstrate zero-shot embodiment generalization with PointPilot. A single trained policy can be deployed on previously unseen embodiments and successfully complete manipulation tasks without any additional fine-tuning.
tldr: PointPilot is a manipulation framework that predicts 3D point flow for task-focused objects (including grippers) from sensor observations and language instructions, enabling unified action execution and zero-shot embodiment generalization across different robots without an extra action head.
tldr_zh: PointPilot是一个操作框架，通过预测任务相关物体（包括抓爪）的3D点流，根据传感器观察和语言指令进行端到端的子任务规划、目标接地和点流预测，实现了不同机器人之间的零样本跨本体泛化，无需额外动作头。
summary_zh: 泛化能力仍是机器人领域的一大核心挑战，要求策略能够应对来自多个维度的域差异，例如不同的机器人本体、相机位姿和/或场景布局。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PointPilot，一个基于三维空间点流预测的、任务聚焦且三维对齐的操作框架。PointPilot并不对全局场景进行建模，而是仅表示任务相关的物体（将机器人夹爪也视为物体），从而避免预测与操作任务无关的潜在冗余场景部分。此外，PointPilot在同一统一坐标系中对齐三维空间表示，并支持基于物体点流的闭环、全自动动作执行，可适用于多种操作模式，而无需单独训练的动作专家模块；相比之下，现有工作通常需要额外的动作头，或仅支持（半）自动且单一机械臂模式。在给定传感器观测和语言指令的条件下，我们的模型以端到端方式联合学习子任务规划、任务相关物体定位以及三维点流预测。通过在共享的三维点流空间中处理异构数据，PointPilot能够吸收来自不同机器人本体的演示数据。大量仿真和真实世界实验验证了我们的方法。特别地，我们展示了PointPilot的零样本本体泛化能力：一个训练好的策略可直接部署到先前未见过的机器人本体上，并在无需任何额外微调的情况下成功完成操作任务。

title: Visuo-tactile Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation with Auxiliary Tactile Dynamics Prediction
summary: Long-horizon robotic assembly requires reliable perception and action across grasping, alignment, and insertion. Vision captures global object pose and scene context, where as fingertip touch provides local contact cues that are especially useful as contact states change. We present a visuotactile diffusion policy that combines four-step histories from two camera views and two fingertip tactile images to condition action-sequence generation. A recurrent temporal representation integrates recent observations from both modalities. To encourage it to capture how contact evolves under action, an auxiliary objective predicts fingertip-image changes two steps ahead from the temporal representation and demonstrated actions. This objective is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Across three independent training seeds in MuJoCo assembly experiments, the full model achieves an average success rate of $59.0\% \pm 2.6\%$, improving on the visual-only baseline ($42.7\% \pm 1.5\%$) by 16.3 percentage points.
tldr: A visuo-tactile diffusion policy conditions action-sequence generation on histories of camera and fingertip tactile images, with an auxiliary training-only objective to predict future tactile changes, improving MuJoCo assembly success over a vision-only baseline.
tldr_zh: 一种视触觉扩散策略，利用摄像头和指尖触觉图像的历史信息来生成动作序列，并引入仅训练时使用的辅助目标预测未来触觉变化，在MuJoCo装配任务上优于纯视觉基线。
summary_zh: 长时程机器人装配任务要求在整个抓取、对准与插入过程中具备可靠的感知与动作能力。视觉信息能够提供物体的全局位姿与场景上下文，而指尖触觉则在接触状态发生变化时提供尤为关键的局部接触线索。我们提出了一种视觉-触觉扩散策略，该策略结合两个相机视角及两个指尖触觉图像的四步历史信息，以条件化动作序列的生成。一种循环时间表示结构对来自两种模态的近期观测进行整合。为促使该表示结构捕捉动作执行过程中接触状态的演化规律，我们引入一个辅助目标，用于从时间表示及示范动作中预测两步之后的指尖图像变化。该目标仅在训练阶段使用，不增加任何推理时计算开销。在MuJoCo装配实验中，基于三个独立训练种子的结果表明，完整模型的平均成功率达到$59.0\% \pm 2.6\%$，相比仅基于视觉的基线方法（$42.7\% \pm 1.5\%$）提升了16.3个百分点。

title: DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon dexterous manipulation remains a fundamental challenge for robot learning, requiring the composition of multiple skills, precise bimanual coordination, generalizable visual understanding, and robust skill transitions. Yet existing manipulation benchmarks largely emphasize isolated skills or support only a limited range of end-effectors, making these capabilities difficult to evaluate systematically. We introduce DexArena, a benchmark designed to evaluate learning and generalization in long-horizon bimanual dexterous manipulation. DexArena features 10 long-horizon tasks and 30 stage-level tasks spanning diverse household and industrial scenarios. Each long-horizon task is composed of explicitly defined stages with physically grounded success conditions, enabling reliable evaluation of both intermediate progress and end-to-end task completion. A unified benchmark interface and verified human-teleoperated demonstrations enable testing different policy learning algorithms, with standardized simulation configurations, scene randomization, trajectory replay, and task-level evaluation. Through extensive baseline experiments, we identify substantial challenges in precise manipulation, generalization to scene variation, and skill composition. DexArena establishes a challenging and reproducible benchmark for developing robot learning methods that move toward generalizable long-horizon dexterous behavior.
tldr: DexArena introduces a unified benchmark with 10 long-horizon and 30 stage-level bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, including human teleoperated demonstrations and standardized evaluation, to systematically assess learning and generalization in long-horizon dexterous manipulation.
tldr_zh: DexArena 提出了一个统一的基准，包含 10 个长时程和 30 个阶段级的双手灵巧操作任务，以及人类遥操作演示和标准化评估，用于系统评估长时程灵巧操作中的学习和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 长时程灵巧操作仍是机器人学习领域的一项基础性挑战，要求具备多种技能的复合、精确的双臂协调、可泛化的视觉理解以及稳健的技能切换能力。然而，现有的操作 benchmarks 大多侧重于单一技能，或仅支持有限类型的末端执行器，使得这些能力难以被系统性地评估。为此，我们提出了 DexArena，一个用于评估长时程双臂灵巧操作中学习与泛化能力的基准平台。DexArena 包含 10 个长时程任务和 30 个阶段性任务，覆盖多种家庭与工业场景。每个长时程任务均由明确定义的阶段组成，并配有基于物理的成功判定条件，从而能够可靠地评估中间进度与端到端任务完成情况。统一的基准接口和经过验证的远程人工操作演示，支持对不同策略学习算法的测试，并提供标准化的仿真配置、场景随机化、轨迹回放以及任务级评估。通过广泛的基线实验，我们识别出在精细操作、场景变化泛化以及技能组合方面存在的显著挑战。DexArena 为开发迈向可泛化长时程灵巧行为的机器人学习方法，提供了一个具有挑战性且可复现的基准平台。

title: W2A: Distilling World Priors into Action Models for Real-Time Robotic Control
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently shown great promise in robotic control, benefiting from the future imagination capability of large-scale pretrained video models. However, most existing WAMs require explicitly imagining future states at test time, incurring substantial computational overhead and latency that make them unsuitable for real-time robotic control. In this paper, we propose W2A, a two-stage distillation framework for real-time robotic manipulation that distills intermediate denoising representations from a video diffusion model into an action model during training, while entirely discarding the video model at test time. We hypothesize that although video latent representations are high-dimensional, a compressed low-dimensional subspace is sufficient to provide effective supervision for action generation. This makes it possible to transfer such information effectively into an action model. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate competitive success rates while significantly improving inference efficiency. On LIBERO, W2A achieves a 95.9% average success rate. More importantly, W2A achieves about 21x faster inference than the representative WAM baseline.
tldr: W2A distills intermediate denoising representations from a video diffusion world model into an action model, enabling real-time robotic manipulation without the video model at test time.
tldr_zh: W2A 将视频扩散世界模型的中间去噪表征蒸馏到动作模型中，在测试时丢弃视频模型，实现实时机器人操作控制。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）近年来在机器人控制领域展现出巨大潜力，这得益于大规模预训练视频模型的未来想象能力。然而，现有的大多数WAMs在测试时需要显式地想象未来状态，这引入了大量的计算开销和延迟，使其不适合实时机器人控制。在本文中，我们提出W2A，一种用于实时机器人操作的两阶段蒸馏框架，该框架在训练期间将视频扩散模型的中间去噪表示蒸馏到动作模型中，而在测试时完全弃用视频模型。我们假设，尽管视频潜在表示是高维的，但一个压缩的低维子空间足以对动作生成提供有效的监督。这使得将这些信息有效迁移到动作模型成为可能。在仿真和真实世界的广泛实验中，我们展示了具有竞争力的成功率，同时显著提高了推理效率。在LIBERO上，W2A实现了95.9%的平均成功率。更重要的是，W2A的推理速度比代表性WAM基线快约21倍。

title: Sequential Recovery Updates for Learned Controllers under Successful-Trajectory Preservation
summary: A competent learned controller already recovers from many disturbances. Improving it means learning a correction, and learning when not to apply it. Freezing a skill's parameters does not settle the second half. In a controller that routes among frozen skills, a new entry rule can redirect the states an old skill succeeded on. We therefore constrain entry instead of parameters. Each update searches for a feedback skill at a measured failure. It fits an entry rule that reads observations and rejects every state on an accumulated successful trajectory. The skill is admitted only if the composed controller reproduces the new recovery on its own and replays every protected trajectory exactly. A finite-trajectory condition states when this preserves the previous controller. One mechanism runs on four streams: two motions on each of two humanoid systems. Two updates per stream add 62 recoveries over 192 withheld perturbations, and lose none of the base controller's successes. We then price that guarantee. Removing the constraint recovers 33 more conditions but stops eight protected ones from completing at all, and excluding only what admission proves necessary recovers none of that cost.
tldr: This paper introduces a method for sequentially updating learned controllers by fitting entry rules that reject states on successful trajectories, preserving all previous successes while adding new recoveries, demonstrated on humanoid systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种顺序更新学习控制器的方法，通过拟合入口规则拒绝成功轨迹上的状态，在保留所有先前成功的同时添加新的恢复，并在人形系统上进行了演示。
summary_zh: 有能力的习得控制器已经能够从许多扰动中恢复。改进它意味着学习一种修正，并学习何时不应用这种修正。冻结技能的参数并不能解决后半部分问题。在一种在冻结技能之间进行路由的控制器中，新的进入规则可以重定向旧技能曾经成功处理的状态。因此，我们约束的是进入规则而非参数。每次更新都会在已测量的失败处搜索一个反馈技能。它拟合一条进入规则，该规则读取观测值并拒绝累积成功轨迹上的每一个状态。只有当组合后的控制器能够自行重现新的恢复行为，并精确重放所有受保护轨迹时，该技能才被接纳。一个有限轨迹条件说明了何时这能保留先前的控制器。该机制在四条流上运行：两个人体系统的每个系统各有两条运动流。每条流两次更新，在192个被剔除的扰动中新增了62个恢复能力，且不损失基础控制器的任何成功表现。随后我们为这一保证定价。移除约束可额外恢复33种情况，但会导致八个受保护情况完全无法完成；而仅排除接纳过程证明必要的内容，则无法收回任何相应代价。

title: Energy-Based Policy Orchestration
summary: Hierarchical control scales robot behavior by separating task-level planning from low-level control. In dynamic, high-dimensional tasks, however, a fixed planner-to-policy interface can fail when contacts, balance, or disturbances evolve faster than high-level policy updates. Execution therefore requires choosing not only which low-level policy to run, but also which policy-specific goal should be given to it. We formulate this problem as policy orchestration: runtime selection of a policy-goal pair that is likely to remain feasible while tracking the planner target. We develop EPO, an energy-based policy orchestrator for modular goal-conditioned policy families. For each policy, EPO learns a composite energy over low-level goals, where lower energy corresponds to higher feasibility and more accurate target realization. At runtime, EPO refines each policy's goal and executes the lowest-energy policy-goal pair. Because energies are policy-specific, new policies can be incorporated by learning their own energy models, without retraining the existing policies or a centralized scheduler. In simulation, EPO improves the empirical precision-robustness trade-off by refining policy-specific goals before selectively switching among policies based on energy scores. We further demonstrate sim-to-real deployment of the same frozen policies and energy models on real humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://yewr.github.io/epo
tldr: EPO is an energy-based policy orchestrator that, at runtime, refines policy-specific goals and switches among modular goal-conditioned policies by selecting the lowest-energy policy-goal pair, improving precision-robustness and enabling sim-to-real humanoid loco-manipulation with frozen policies and energy models.
tldr_zh: EPO提出一种基于能量的策略编排器，在运行时为每个低层策略细化其专属目标，并根据能量分数选择最可行的策略-目标对进行切换，在仿真中提升了精度与鲁棒性的权衡，并实现了在真实人形移动操作任务上的零样本迁移部署。
summary_zh:
摘要：
分层控制通过将任务级规划与底层控制分离，从而对机器人行为进行分级缩放。然而，在动态、高维任务中，当接触、平衡或扰动变化的速度快于高层策略更新时，固定的规划器到策略接口可能会失效。因此，执行时不仅需要选择运行哪个底层策略，还需要选择应向其提供哪个策略特定的目标。我们将该问题形式化为策略编排：在运行时选择一个策略–目标对，使其在跟踪规划器目标的同时，仍可能保持可行。我们提出了EPO，一种用于模块化目标条件策略族的基于能量的策略编排器。对于每个策略，EPO学习低层目标上的复合能量，其中较低能量对应较高可行性以及更准确的目标实现。在运行时，EPO细化每个策略的目标，并执行能量最低的策略–目标对。由于能量是策略特定的，新策略可以通过学习其自身的能量模型来纳入，而无需重新训练现有策略或集中式调度器。在仿真中，EPO通过在基于能量分数有选择地在策略之间切换之前细化策略特定目标，改善了经验上的精度–鲁棒性权衡。我们进一步展示了相同的冻结策略和能量模型在真实人形移动操作任务上的仿真到现实部署。项目网站：https://yewr.github.io/epo

title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
summary: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.
tldr: RoboColosseum is a distributed evaluation framework for benchmarking VLA policies and AI agents across diverse robots, tasks, and environments via standardized pairwise trials, revealing generalization, adaptation, and progress insights.
tldr_zh: RoboColosseum 是一个分布式评估框架，通过标准化的成对试验在多样化的机器人、任务和环境上对 VLA 策略和 AI 智能体进行基准测试，揭示了泛化、适应和进度方面的见解。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人策略必须能够跨机器人、跨任务、跨环境工作，然而，使得物理试验具有信息价值的多样性，同时也使其难以复现。我们推出了RoboColosseum，一个分布式评估框架，该框架在多样环境中，通过统一策略服务与标准化协议，连接起一个由本地操作机器人组成的网络。我们的初步研究评估了五种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略和三种前沿AI智能体，横跨四种实体平台（SO-101、Franka、Bimanual-YAM和G1人形机器人）。开放赛道（Open Track）在匹配的本地条件下，通过盲法、成对试验比较模型，无需任务特定调整。微调赛道（Fine-tune Track）则衡量VLA策略在每种策略每项任务获得相同数量（100个）演示时，如何适应全部四种实体平台上的20项任务。在124个站点的5,699次成对开放赛道比较中，前沿智能体与专用VLA策略不相上下，而所有系统在可靠完成开放式世界任务方面均显困难。微调后，GR00T N1.7在SO-101上领先，pi0.5在Franka和Bimanual-YAM上领先。策略排名在不同实体平台的任务套件间一致性较弱（Kendall W = 0.24）。开放赛道排名对微调后的相对性能预测不佳，在两个赛道共有的所有三种实体平台上出现显著的排名反转。衡量部分进展揭示了仅凭任务完成情况无法显现的差异。在G1人形机器人上，没有策略完成五项任务中的任何一项，但各策略的平均进展范围在13.3%至23.2%之间。随着试验积累，开放赛道排名趋于稳定，而主动匹配在显著减少物理试验次数的同时，达成了与均匀采样相当排名一致性。这些结果表明，分布式物理评估如何揭示机器人策略的泛化之处、它们适应新任务的程度，以及在未能完成的任务上所能取得的进展幅度。

title: Learning Purposeful Co-designs of Bio-inspired Quadrupedal Robots
summary: Treating morphology and control as separate design problems has constrained the efficiency and adaptability of quadrupedal robots, while current co-design approaches are often constrained by restricted design spaces. We overcome this limit by introducing Dogger, a bio-inspired quadruped with modular three-segment legs, four-bar linkages and adjustable passive knee compliance. A two-stage framework combining reinforcement learning and Bayesian optimization is developed: the morphology-conditioned control policy is trained across designs and then held fixed during task-specific design selection. The resulting designs and policies deployed zero-shot reduce the cost of transport by 18.6% and 35.7% for inspection and payload-carrying tasks. Comparisons demonstrate that full geometry-compliance co-design outperforms fixed and restricted design scopes. Cross-task tests further reveal distinct task-specific morphologies with shared mechanical trade-offs. These results provide hardware-level evidence that expanding the physical design space alongside learned control is essential to realize the full potential of task-driven morphology-control co-design in legged robotics.
tldr: The paper introduces Dogger, a bio-inspired quadruped robot with modular legs and adjustable compliance, and uses a two-stage co-design framework combining RL and Bayesian optimization to optimize morphology and control jointly, achieving significant energy efficiency improvements in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Dogger，一种具有模块化腿和可调被动膝关节柔顺性的仿生四足机器人，并采用结合强化学习和贝叶斯优化的两阶段协同设计框架，在真实任务中实现了显著的能效提升。
summary_zh: 将形态与控制视为两个独立的设计问题，限制了四足机器人的效率与适应性，而现有的协同设计方法往往受限于狭窄的设计空间。我们通过引入Dogger——一种具有模块化三段式腿部、四连杆机构及可调被动膝关节柔顺性的仿生四足机器人——突破了这一限制。我们开发了一个结合强化学习与贝叶斯优化的两阶段框架：先在不同设计间训练形态条件化控制策略，再在任务特定的设计选择中保持该策略固定。由此产生的设计与策略在零样本部署中，分别将巡检任务和载物任务的运输成本降低了18.6%和35.7%。对比实验表明，完整的几何-柔顺性协同设计优于固定或受限的设计范围。跨任务测试进一步揭示了不同任务特有的形态，同时共享着机械上的权衡取舍。这些结果为硬件层面提供了证据，表明在腿足机器人中，扩展物理设计空间并与学习控制相结合，是实现任务驱动型形态-控制协同设计全部潜力的关键。

title: When to Probe and When to Act: Clarity-Aware Risk-Adaptive Control for Interactive Driving
summary: Safe navigation in interactive traffic requires autonomous vehicles to reason about unobservable human characteristics and the reciprocal nature of multi-agent interactions. Traditional architectures often decouple prediction from planning, leading to the "Frozen Robot Problem" or unsafe maneuvers under high ambiguity because they treat risk assessment and information acquisition as independent objectives. We argue that the notion of safety should not remain static but must instead dynamically co-evolve with the system's internal confidence: the robot should actively clarify ambiguity when necessary while also recognizing the diminishing returns of information, and naturally transition toward task execution. We introduce a unified belief-space Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that couples multistep information planning with a clarity-adaptive Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) barrier mechanism. By treating clarity, a scalar informational state, as an explicit planning variable, the controller co-designs its probing strategy with its safety specification, tightening conservatism under high ambiguity and relaxing constraints as confidence improves. We further provide a performance analysis showing that the cost of information seeking and the expected planning-cost gap to a controller that knows the true human characteristic are bounded by residual ambiguity and solver error. We evaluate the framework in lane-merging and unsignalized-intersection scenarios against representative interactive-planning baselines. Across 5,000 simulations, the proposed method achieves the highest success rates (94.6% and 93.2%) and the lowest collision rates (1.2% and 1.4%) among the compared methods, providing a principled foundation for robust decision-making in human-centric environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a belief-space MPC framework for interactive driving that couples multistep information planning with a clarity-adaptive CVaR barrier mechanism, dynamically balancing active ambiguity reduction and task execution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于交互式驾驶的信念空间MPC框架，将多步信息规划与清晰度自适应CVaR障碍机制相结合，动态平衡主动消除歧义与任务执行。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在交互式交通中实现安全导航，要求自动驾驶车辆能够对不可观测的人类特征以及多智能体交互的互惠性质进行推理。传统架构通常将预测与规划解耦，导致出现“冻结机器人问题”或在高度模糊情况下采取不安全机动，因为它们将风险评估和信息获取视为相互独立的目标。我们认为，安全的概念不应保持静态，而应与系统内部置信度动态共同演化：机器人应在必要时主动澄清模糊性，同时也要认识到信息收益的递减，并自然过渡到任务执行。我们提出了一种统一的信念空间模型预测控制（MPC）框架，将多步信息规划与清晰度自适应条件风险价值（CVaR）障碍机制相结合。通过将清晰度这一标量信息状态视为显式规划变量，控制器将其探测策略与安全规范协同设计，在高模糊性下收紧保守性，并随着置信度提高而放松约束。我们进一步提供了一项性能分析，表明信息寻求的成本以及相对于已知真实人类特征的控制器的期望规划成本差距，均受剩余模糊性和求解器误差的约束。我们在车道汇入和无信号交叉口场景中，针对具有代表性的交互式规划基线对该框架进行了评估。在5，000次仿真中，所提方法在对比方法中取得了最高的成功率（94.6%和93.2%）以及最低的碰撞率（1.2%和1.4%），为以人为中心环境中的鲁棒决策提供了有原则的基础。

title: GoalDex: Learning Image-Goal-Conditioned Policies for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
summary: Dexterous in-hand manipulation is commonly formulated around explicit object pose estimation, yet reliable pose tracking is challenging under severe hand-object occlusions and often requires object-specific supervision. This dependence creates a bottleneck between perception and control that can limit robustness and scalability. We present an end-to-end visuomotor framework for dexterous in-hand reorientation that operates on RGB observations and proprioception without intermediate pose estimation. Our approach jointly learns visual representations and control policies through behavior distillation from privileged state teachers and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. Furthermore, we introduce image-goal-conditioned reorientation, allowing desired object configurations to be specified directly through images rather than canonical pose representations. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of object geometries and instances in simulation, where it consistently outperforms pose-based methods and policies built on pretrained visual encoders. Finally, we demonstrate direct sim-to-real transfer of a single image-goal-conditioned policy across five real-world objects, showing that accurate dexterous reorientation can be achieved without explicit pose estimation. For videos and code release, please refer to the project website: https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/goaldex/
tldr: GoalDex learns end-to-end image-goal-conditioned visuomotor policies for dexterous in-hand reorientation without explicit pose estimation, using behavior distillation from privileged state teachers and auxiliary reconstruction, with direct sim-to-real transfer to five real objects.
tldr_zh: GoalDex提出一种端到端图像目标条件的视觉运动策略，无需显式位姿估计即可实现灵巧手内重定向，通过特权状态教师的行为蒸馏与辅助重建目标联合学习，并成功将单一策略直接迁移到五个真实物体。
summary_zh: 灵巧手内操作通常以显式物体姿态估计为核心，然而在手-物严重遮挡下，可靠的姿态跟踪极具挑战性，且往往需要针对特定物体的监督信息。这种依赖性在感知与控制之间形成了瓶颈，可能限制系统的鲁棒性和可扩展性。我们提出了一种端到端的视觉运动框架，用于灵巧手内重定向操作，该框架仅依赖RGB观测和本体感觉，无需中间姿态估计。通过从特权状态教师模型中提取行为，并结合辅助重构目标，我们的方法联合学习视觉表征与控制策略。此外，我们引入以图像目标为条件的重定向方式，使得期望的物体配置可直接通过图像指定，而非使用规范姿态表征。我们在模拟环境中对多种物体几何形状和实例进行了评估，所提出的方法在性能上持续优于基于姿态的方法以及基于预训练视觉编码器的策略。最后，我们展示了单一图像目标条件策略在五种真实世界物体上的直接仿真到现实迁移，证明无需显式姿态估计即可实现精准的灵巧重定向。视频和代码发布请参见项目网站：https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/goaldex/

title: When Delay Meets Drift: Physical Safety of Robot Foundation Models Is a Cross-Layer Problem
summary: Robot foundation models now act in a closed loop, yet their safety is evaluated one variation at a time: robustness benchmarks perturb the scene while assuming instantaneous inference, and real-time execution methods study inference delay in nominal scenes. We argue that physical safety is not a property of the model alone, but emerges from how variations in the physical environment, the model, the computing platform, and execution interact in closed loop. We formalize this as cross-layer variation propagation across these system layers and use an interaction contrast to measure when joint variation creates more risk than the sum of its parts. In 4,000 paired closed-loop episodes of the pi0.5 vision-language-action model on LIBERO, a 400 ms inference delay raises the safety-violation rate by 3.5 percentage points under the training viewpoint but by 37 percentage points under a 60-degree camera shift: 33.5 percentage points (95% CI: 25-43) more than the two effects combined. We close with a research agenda toward predictable physical intelligence: predicting when variation becomes risk, and adapting compute, power, and control accordingly.
tldr: This paper investigates the physical safety of robot foundation models, showing that interactions between environmental variations, model inference delays, and execution dynamics create compounded safety risks that exceed the sum of individual effects, using the pi0.5 VLA model on LIBERO as a case study.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了机器人基础模型的物理安全性，表明环境变化、模型推理延迟和执行动态之间的相互作用会产生超过各部分之和的复合安全风险，并以pi0.5 VLA模型在LIBERO上的实验为例。
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型如今以闭环方式运行，但其安全性仍是逐变式评估：鲁棒性基准在假设瞬时推理的前提下扰动场景，而实时执行方法则在名义场景中研究推理延迟。我们认为，物理安全并非模型自身的单一属性，而是源于物理环境、模型、计算平台与执行之间的变化在闭环中相互作用的结果。我们将其形式化为跨这些系统层的跨层变化传播，并采用交互对比来衡量联合变化何时产生比各部分效应之和更大的风险。在LIBERO上对pi0.5视觉-语言-动作模型进行的4,000组配对闭环试验中，训练视角下400毫秒的推理延迟使安全违规率上升3.5个百分点，而在60度相机偏移下，该延迟使安全违规率上升37个百分点——比两种效应单独叠加的预测值高出33.5个百分点（95%置信区间：25-43）。最后，我们提出一项面向可预测物理智能的研究议程：预测变化何时转化为风险，并相应调整计算、功率与控制策略。

title: Scaling Action-Free Video Latent Prediction for Transferable Representations in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies require effective visual representations that capture both spatial scene structure and temporal dynamics. Video latent prediction has emerged as an effective paradigm for learning spatiotemporal visual representations, yet it remains unclear whether scaling this objective with action-free driving videos can yield representations that benefit end-to-end planning. We study action-free video latent prediction as a scalable pretraining objective and introduce ScaleDrive, a driving-oriented framework pretrained exclusively on large-scale internet open-world driving videos, without action annotations or benchmark-specific data. We keep the pretrained video encoder frozen during downstream end-to-end planning training to isolate the transferability of representations learned from internet driving videos. Ego-motion and depth probes show that scaling action-free video pretraining progressively strengthens the temporal and geometric information encoded in the frozen representation. We systematically study the visual representation transfer across different end-to-end driving policies and closed-loop benchmarks, where ScaleDrive consistently improves downstream performance and demonstrates that scaling action-free video latent prediction yields representations that generalize across both planning policy architectures and evaluation scenarios and protocols.
tldr: ScaleDrive pretrains a frozen video encoder on action-free internet driving videos via latent prediction, and shows that scaling this objective improves transferable spatiotemporal representations for end-to-end autonomous driving planning across architectures and benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ScaleDrive 通过在无动作的互联网驾驶视频上进行潜在预测预训练，并冻结视频编码器，验证了扩展该目标可提升端到端自动驾驶规划的可迁移时空表征，且跨架构和基准泛化。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶策略需要有效的视觉表征，以同时捕捉空间场景结构和时间动态。视频潜变量预测已成为学习时空视觉表征的有效范式，然而，这一目标是否能够通过无动作驾驶视频的扩展来产生有益于端到端规划的视觉表征，目前仍不明确。我们研究了将无动作视频潜变量预测作为一种可扩展的预训练目标，并提出了ScaleDrive——一个完全在大规模互联网开放世界驾驶视频上预训练的面向驾驶的框架，无需动作标注或特定于基准测试的数据。在下游端到端规划训练中，我们保持预训练视频编码器冻结，以隔离从互联网驾驶视频中学习到的表征的可迁移性。自我运动与深度探针实验表明，扩展无动作视频预训练能够逐步增强冻结表征中编码的时间与几何信息。我们系统性地研究了视觉表征在不同端到端驾驶策略和闭环基准测试之间的迁移，ScaleDrive持续提升下游性能，并证明扩展无动作视频潜变量预测能够产生在规划策略架构以及评估场景和协议上均具有泛化能力的表征。

title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.
tldr: History Forcing introduces a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video world models, improving long-horizon consistency and out-of-sight scene evolution by aligning student predictions with teacher residuals weighted by historical context.
tldr_zh: History Forcing 提出了一种统一的在线策略蒸馏框架，通过利用历史上下文增强少步自回归视频世界模型的监督信号，从而提升长时程生成的一致性以及物体离开视野后的场景演化合理性。
summary_zh: 少步自回归视频扩散能够实现高效生成，但在长时间展开中保持一致性仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当主体或场景在离开视野后重新出现时。尽管在保真度和展开鲁棒性方面已取得进展，现有蒸馏方法仍未充分利用更丰富的历史信息来约束学生模型的当前预测。为填补这一空白，我们提出了**History Forcing**，一个统一的同策略蒸馏框架，用于增强少步自回归视频生成器的历史监督。该框架利用教师模型在有信息性历史上下文和无信息性历史上下文下预测之间的残差来解耦这一监督信号。这样的历史上下文可以通过使用累积漂移较少的早期生成片段，或使用固定视角的教师展开来获得，后者在学生模型视线移开时保持场景可见。随后，该残差被加权并添加到用于蒸馏的分数或速度预测中，形成校正目标。通过蒸馏使学生模型与该校正目标对齐，History Forcing将长程历史约束纳入自回归生成。我们的方法在1.3B模型中达到了最先进性能：15秒视频生成的VBench质量得分为85.07，60秒生成的VBench-Long综合得分为79.82。对于视野外世界建模，评估进一步展示了更合理的场景演化以及相机返回时更一致的状态，PlayWorld上的演化质量从2.35提升至2.70，MemoBench上的物体一致性从58.43提升至62.18。

title: ReinSeg: Retrieval-Guided Bounded Multimodal Refinement for 3-D Road Anomaly Segmentation
summary: 3-D road anomaly segmentation is essential for risk-aware perception in autonomous driving. Its central challenge is to rank sparsely observed hazards ahead of abundant normal road structures while preserving point-wise metric localization. LiDAR provides accurate 3-D point support, whereas surround-view imagery offers complementary semantic context for separating unexpected hazards from challenging normal structures. We propose ReinSeg, a retrieval-guided bounded multimodal refinement framework for point-wise road anomaly segmentation. Occupied LiDAR bird's-eye-view cells retrieve scene-specific context from a shared memory of eight surround-view images without supplying calibration variables to the retrieval module. A relative-norm-bounded residual returns this context to the LiDAR point features, so the frozen LIDO anomaly-scoring interface is preserved, and the refinement is optimized with in-distribution semantic labels only. On the Spotting the Unexpected (STU) benchmark, ReinSeg improves validation average precision from 27.54\% to 35.67\% and reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% anomaly recall from 34.85\% to 10.61\%, shrinking the high-recall screening set from 67.54 to 20.55 million points. Relative to REL, AP is 24.99 percentage points higher and FPR95 is 0.99 points lower. Matched interfaces and component isolation show that retrieved scene imagery and the relative-norm bound are both essential, and ReinSeg stays above LiDAR-only performance under missing, corrupted, or misaligned camera inputs while running at 21.8 frames per second. These results establish bounded retrieval of scene-specific visual evidence as an effective route to reliable 3-D road-hazard perception.
tldr: ReinSeg is a retrieval-guided bounded multimodal refinement framework that fuses LiDAR with surround-view imagery via a shared memory to improve point-wise 3D road anomaly segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art AP and FPR95 on the STU benchmark while remaining robust to camera degradation and running at 21.8 FPS.
tldr_zh: ReinSeg 提出一种检索引导的有界多模态精炼框架，通过共享记忆库将 LiDAR 与环视图像融合，显著提升三维道路异常分割的平均精度并降低误检率，在 STU 基准上达到最优，且对相机缺失、损坏或错位具有鲁棒性并保持 21.8 FPS 的实时性能。
summary_zh: 三维道路异常分割对于自动驾驶中的风险感知至关重要。其核心挑战在于，在大量正常道路结构之前，对稀疏观测到的危险目标进行排序，同时保持逐点的度量定位。激光雷达提供了精确的三维点云支撑，而环绕视图图像则提供了互补的语义上下文，用于将意外危险与具有挑战性的正常结构区分开来。我们提出了ReinSeg，一种用于逐点道路异常分割的检索引导有界多模态精化框架。占据的激光雷达鸟瞰图单元从八幅环绕视图图像的共享记忆中检索场景特定上下文，而无需向检索模块提供标定变量。相对范数有界残差将该上下文返回至激光雷达点特征，从而保留了冻结的LIDO异常评分接口，且精化过程仅使用分布内语义标签进行优化。在Spotting the Unexpected (STU)基准上，ReinSeg将验证平均精度从27.54\%提升至35.67\%，并在95\%异常召回率下将误报率从34.85\%降低至10.61\%，将高召回筛选集从6754万点缩减至2055万点。相对于REL，平均精度提高24.99个百分点，FPR95降低0.99个百分点。接口匹配与组件消融实验表明，检索到的场景图像和相对范数界均至关重要，且在相机输入缺失、损坏或错位的情况下，ReinSeg仍保持高于仅激光雷达的性能，同时以每秒21.8帧的速度运行。这些结果确立了场景特定视觉证据的有界检索作为实现可靠三维道路危险感知的有效途径。

title: Fast-Slow Evolutionary Occupancy Prediction via Controlled Dynamics
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction provides dense geometric and semantic scene representations for autonomous driving, where both high accuracy and low response latency are crucial for safe downstream forecasting and planning. Existing methods usually exhibit different accuracy-latency characteristics. Performance-oriented models provide stronger geometric and semantic predictions, while deployment-friendly models provide faster responses. This motivates EvoOcc, a fast-slow evolutionary occupancy prediction framework that jointly exploits their complementary strengths to improve the accuracy-latency balance without changing the upstream architectures. EvoOcc models evolutionary occupancy prediction as a continuous time controlled dynamical system, enabling flexible adaptation to variable slow system delays and irregular fast system arrivals. The framework further decomposes the evolution process into dual state evolution where ego state evolution compensates for the deterministic coordinate shifts and scene state evolution models the genuine geometric and semantic scene changes. Extensive experiments on three different fast-slow system pairs and irregular prediction arrivals show that EvoOcc consistently improves over fast system baselines while maintaining much lower latency than the slow system, indicating a favorable accuracy-latency balance and stable behavior under practical inference situations.
tldr: EvoOcc introduces a fast-slow evolutionary occupancy prediction framework for autonomous driving, modeled as a continuous-time controlled dynamical system, to improve accuracy-latency balance by fusing complementary strengths of performance-oriented and deployment-friendly models.
tldr_zh: EvoOcc提出了一种用于自动驾驶的快慢演化占据预测框架，将其建模为连续时间受控动力系统，通过融合高性能与高速度模型的互补优势来改善精度与延迟的平衡。
summary_zh: 3D语义占据预测为自动驾驶提供密集的几何与语义场景表示，其中高精度和低响应延迟对于安全的下游预测与规划都至关重要。现有方法通常表现出不同的精度-延迟特性。面向性能的模型提供更强的几何与语义预测，而面向部署的模型则提供更快的响应。这促使了EvoOcc的提出，这是一个快慢演化占据预测框架，能够联合利用两者的互补优势，在不改变上游架构的情况下改善精度-延迟平衡。EvoOcc将演化占据预测建模为连续时间受控动力系统，从而能够灵活适应可变的慢系统延迟和不规则的快系统到达。该框架进一步将演化过程分解为双状态演化，其中自车状态演化补偿确定性的坐标偏移，场景状态演化则建模真实的几何与语义场景变化。在三个不同的快慢系统对以及不规则预测到达上的大量实验表明，EvoOcc在快系统基线上持续取得提升，同时保持远低于慢系统的延迟，表明其具有有利的精度-延迟平衡，并在实际推理情境下表现出稳定的行为。

title: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models (WAMs) use video-generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Yet RGB futures entangle physical state changes with appearance, while frame-wise depth and point maps lack temporal correspondence. Existing 4D approaches either keep motion implicit in visual features or translate predicted traces into actions through a separate interface. We present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field encoding the cross-frame image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. By placing embodiment motion and object responses in a shared space, GeoDelta exposes their motion relations to the action expert at inference. Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) uses these relations to focus spatial readout on task-relevant interaction regions, while Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) aggregates evidence around changes in their relative motion, such as grasp and release. GeoDelta describes surface motion independently of embodiment-specific controls, providing a shared human--robot quasi-action for action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H followed by robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms the strongest real-robot baseline by 7.0 and 16.0 percentage points under in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively.
tldr: Gnomon4D introduces a world-action model that jointly predicts future video, robot actions, and a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field (GeoDelta), using interaction-salient attention and transition-anchored aggregation to improve policy learning and real-robot performance.
tldr_zh: Gnomon4D 提出了一种世界动作模型，联合预测未来视频、机器人动作和视频对齐的4D几何运动场（GeoDelta），通过交互显著注意力和过渡锚定聚合来提升策略学习和真实机器人性能。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）利用视频生成先验，联合预测未来观测与机器人动作。然而，RGB未来帧将物理状态变化与外观信息纠缠在一起，而逐帧深度图和点图则缺乏时间对应关系。现有的4D方法要么将运动信息隐含在视觉特征中，要么通过独立接口将预测轨迹转换为动作。我们提出Gnomon4D，一种世界-动作模型，可联合生成未来视频、机器人动作以及GeoDelta——一种与视频对齐的4D几何运动场，编码实体点和物体点的跨帧图像平面位移与深度变化。通过将实体运动与物体响应置于共享空间中，GeoDelta在推理时向动作专家暴露了它们的运动关系。交互显著注意力（InSAttn）利用这些关系将空间读取聚焦于任务相关的交互区域，而过渡锚定聚合（TransAgg）则围绕相对运动的变化（如抓取和释放）聚合证据。GeoDelta描述表面运动时独立于具体实体的控制方式，为无动作预训练提供了共享的人-机器人准动作，在EgoManip-5000H上进行预训练，随后在Robot-30H上进行机器人中期训练。Gnomon4D在RoboTwin~2.0、VLABench和RoboDojo上均取得领先，并在分布内和分布外设置下分别比最强真实机器人基线高出7.0和16.0个百分点。

title: SVD-Prune: Spectral Vision Token Pruning under Extreme Compression
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process hundreds of visual tokens, making visual representations a major computational bottleneck. We argue that visual token pruning should be formulated not as identifying individually important tokens, but as preserving the dominant low-rank spectral structure of the visual representation. Based on this formulation, we introduce SVD-Prune, a training-free framework that leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and statistical leverage scores for globally informed token selection. SVD-Prune is architecture-agnostic and can be applied at different stages of the multimodal pipeline, including encoder-side, decoder-side, and hybrid configurations Extensive experiments across VLM and VLA benchmarks demonstrate strong robustness under extreme compression. SVD-Prune reduces the visual token. SVD-Prune cuts the visual token budget by up to 99.3%, while, at a 16-token budget, encoder-side pruning lowers inference FLOPs by 82.4% and achieves a 4.18x end-to-end speedup, including pruning overhead.
tldr: SVD-Prune introduces a training-free SVD-based visual token pruning method for VLMs and VLAs, preserving spectral structure to achieve extreme token compression and large speedups.
tldr_zh: SVD-Prune 提出了一种基于 SVD 的无训练视觉 token 剪枝方法，通过保留谱结构在 VLM 和 VLA 中实现极致的 token 压缩与大幅加速。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要处理数百个视觉标记，这使得视觉表示成为主要的计算瓶颈。我们认为，视觉标记剪枝不应被定义为识别单个重要标记，而应视为保留视觉表示中占主导地位的低秩谱结构。基于这一思路，我们提出了SVD-Prune，一个无需训练的计算框架，利用奇异值分解（SVD）和统计杠杆分数进行全局信息感知的标记选择。SVD-Prune与模型架构无关，可应用于多模态流水线的不同阶段，包括编码器端、解码器端以及混合配置。在VLM和VLA基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在极端压缩条件下具有强大的鲁棒性。SVD-Prune可将视觉标记预算最多减少99.3%，而在16个标记的预算下，编码器端剪枝可将推理FLOPs降低82.4%，并实现4.18倍的端到端加速（包括剪枝开销在内）。

title: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation benefits from tactile feedback that captures both detailed contact geometry and interaction forces. When scooping grains, contact patterns help infer spoon orientation, while resistance transmitted through the grasp guides motion. To provide these complementary sensing capabilities, we present PanoTac, a low-cost, compliant tactile fingertip designed for dense three-axis tactile sensing. Each fingertip provides a $12 \times 32 \times 3$ tactile representation, with one normal ($z$) and two shear ($x$, $y$) response components at each taxel. The sensor operates at 60 Hz and costs less than $50 per fingertip. Sensor characterization quantifies response repeatability and consistency across sensor instances and contact locations. We integrate PanoTac into a robotic system with a visuo-tactile pipeline. Across test-tube preparation, grain scooping, and salt pouring, the resulting policies outperform vision-only baselines by an average of 46.7 percentage points. Ablations show that removing either spatial contact information or shear feedback reduces overall performance across the task suite. Our project page is available at https://panotac.github.io.
tldr: This paper introduces PanoTac, a low-cost dense three-axis tactile sensor for robotic fingertips, and integrates it into a visuo-tactile pipeline that significantly improves performance on contact-rich manipulation tasks such as scooping and pouring.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本、密集三轴触觉传感器PanoTac，并将其集成到视觉-触觉流水线中，显著提升了舀取、倒盐等接触丰富操作任务的性能。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作得益于触觉反馈，该反馈同时捕捉详细的接触几何形状和交互力。在舀取颗粒物时，接触模式有助于推断勺子的方向，而通过抓握传递的阻力则引导运动。为了提供这些互补的感知能力，我们提出了PanoTac，一种低成本、柔顺的触觉指尖，专为密集的三轴触觉传感设计。每个指尖提供$12 \times 32 \times 3$的触觉表示，每个触觉单元包含一个法向（$z$）和两个剪切（$x$，$y$）响应分量。该传感器以60 Hz的频率工作，每个指尖的成本低于50美元。传感器表征量化了响应可重复性以及传感器实例和接触位置间的一致性。我们将PanoTac集成到一个具有视觉-触觉管道的机器人系统中。在试管准备、颗粒舀取和盐分倾倒任务中，所得到的策略相比仅基于视觉的基线平均提高了46.7个百分点。消融实验表明，移除空间接触信息或剪切反馈会降低整个任务套件的整体性能。我们的项目页面可在https://panotac.github.io访问。

title: Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Pre-touch sensing, or sensing information about an object before contact, is an attractive modality for robot hands as it can allow a robot to anticipate and respond to a contact before it happens. In this work, we introduce ToFTouch, a multimodal tactile sensor combining three multizone (4$\times$4 resolution) time-of-flight sensors with an optics-based pressure sensing array. We mount this sensor on a parallel jaw gripper and demonstrate its utility on three distinct tasks: (i) pre-grasp adjustment, (ii) item extraction from clutter, and (iii) item insertion into tight spaces. For pre-grasp adjustment, ToF feedback reduced cycle time by 7.4$\%$ by enabling anticipatory gripper closure during approach. For extraction, ToF sensing enabled successful retrieval across all tested depth offsets ($\pm$2 cm) deviating from the nominal pick point, including conditions where baseline approaches failed, with standard deviations below 0.4 cm. For insertion into dense clutter, we explore the proximity and tactile information provided from ToFTouch during an insertion trajectory. The results demonstrate the utility of multizone ToF sensing in a manipulation environment.
tldr: ToFTouch is a multimodal tactile sensor combining multizone time-of-flight proximity sensing with an optics-based pressure array, mounted on a parallel jaw gripper and demonstrated on pre-grasp adjustment, clutter extraction, and tight-space insertion tasks.
tldr_zh: ToFTouch是一种多模态触觉传感器，将多区域飞行时间接近觉传感与光学压力阵列相结合，安装在平行夹爪上，并在预抓取调整、杂乱物品提取和狭小空间插入任务中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 预接触感知，即在物体接触前获取其相关信息的能力，是机器人手部一种极具吸引力的感知方式，因为它能让机器人在接触发生之前进行预判并作出响应。在本研究中，我们介绍了一种名为ToFTouch的多模态触觉传感器，该传感器将三个多区域（4×4分辨率）飞行时间传感器与基于光学原理的压力传感阵列相结合。我们将该传感器安装于平行夹爪上，并展示了其在三项不同任务中的实用性：（i）预抓取调整，（ii）从杂乱环境中提取物品，以及（iii）将物品插入狭窄空间。在预抓取调整任务中，借助飞行时间（ToF）反馈，夹爪可在接近过程中提前闭合，从而使循环时间缩短了7.4%。在提取任务中，ToF传感技术能够在所有测试的深度偏移（±2厘米）条件下成功实现物品取回，即使这些条件偏离标称拾取点，甚至包括基线方法失效的情况，其标准差均低于0.4厘米。在密集杂乱环境中的插入任务里，我们探究了ToFTouch在插入轨迹过程中所提供的邻近感知与触觉信息。研究结果表明，多区域ToF传感技术在操控环境中具有显著的应用价值。

title: Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation
summary: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.
tldr: This paper evaluates whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information improves lunar traversability estimation, finding no consistent improvement over a visual-only baseline and that training source is the dominant factor in cross-domain transfer.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了将深度几何信息增强到视觉特征中是否能提高月球可通行性估计，发现相比纯视觉基线没有一致改进，训练数据源是跨域迁移的主要因素。
summary_zh: 自主移动对于持续的月面作业至关重要，因为通信延迟和视线遮挡限制了连续遥操作。尽管近年来可通行性估计方法越来越依赖深度学习，但地球模拟环境与真实月球地形之间的域差距可能限制其泛化能力，且真实月面可通行性标注稀缺，使得全监督训练困难重重。为应对这些挑战，我们构建了一个基于稀疏成对标注的弱监督框架，并研究了在视觉特征基础上增强深度衍生几何信息——深度、表面法向量及组合几何描述符——的效果。我们使用两个地球模拟数据集和真实月面嫦娥PCAM数据集，在域内和跨域两种设置下评估模型。与预期相反，我们发现朴素几何增强在两种设置下相较于强视觉基线均未带来一致的性能提升，其影响相对随机种子间的方差而言较小。相反，训练数据源的选择成为迁移质量的主导因素：在域相关数据源上训练的模型迁移至真实月面图像的效果，显著优于几何融合策略对任何单一模型的改进。我们的评估在资源受限的边缘设备上运行，为未来月面感知系统中设计更具表达力的多模态融合架构提供了受控基线。

title: Safe-Ballbot: Tilt-Consistent MPC with Control Barrier Functions for Ballbot Navigation
summary: Ball-balancing robots (ballbots) must lean to accelerate, and the lean is limited by the wheel torques and by safety. Planners that use the full robot model are expensive, while planners that ignore the balance dynamics produce references that cannot be followed. This paper presents a two-layer navigation scheme for a three-omni-wheel ballbot. The upper layer is a model predictive controller on a \emph{jerk model} of the ball position, with discrete-time control barrier functions for static, moving, rotating and concave obstacles. The lower layer is a hierarchical sliding mode controller with an extended state observer and a robust exponential control barrier function on the tilt (HSMC-ESO-ECBF). The layers are linked by an acceleration bound derived in closed form from the largest steady tilt that the barrier function admits, so that the plan never asks for a lean the tracker refuses. For obstacles whose motion is only predicted, the obstacles are inflated by conformal prediction radii that bound the prediction error with a prescribed probability. In MuJoCo, with omni-wheel roller contacts and torque saturation, the scheme keeps at least $10$\,cm of clearance, tracks the plan within $2$\,cm RMS, keeps the tilt below the limit and plans in $9$--$12$\,ms, $10$--$15$ times faster than a full-model nonlinear MPC that enters the inflated obstacles; with predicted obstacles, the conformal inflation removes the collisions of a constant-velocity predictor in $30$ random crossing scenarios and reduces them in an endless run on a closed path.The source code and video illustrations are available at https://safe-ballbot.github.io
tldr: This paper presents a two-layer navigation scheme for a three-omni-wheel ballbot, combining a jerk-model MPC with discrete-time control barrier functions and a hierarchical sliding mode controller with an extended state observer and robust exponential CBF, linked by a closed-form acceleration bound derived from the maximum steady tilt.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种三层全方位轮平衡机器人的两层导航方案，上层为基于急动度模型和离散时间控制障碍函数的模型预测控制器，下层为带扩展状态观测器和鲁棒指数控制障碍函数的分层滑模控制器，二者通过由最大稳态倾角闭式推导的加速度约束相联系。
summary_zh: 球平衡机器人（ballbot）必须倾斜才能加速，而倾斜受到轮扭矩和安全性的限制。使用完整机器人模型的规划器计算成本高昂，而忽略平衡动力学的规划器生成的参考轨迹无法被跟踪。本文提出了一种用于三轮全向ballbot的两层导航方案。上层是基于球位置\emph{加加速度模型}的模型预测控制器，配有用于静态、移动、旋转和凹形障碍物的离散时间控制障碍函数。下层是带有扩展状态观测器和倾角鲁棒指数控制障碍函数的递阶滑模控制器（HSMC-ESO-ECBF）。两层之间通过一个加速度上界进行连接，该上界由障碍函数所允许的最大稳态倾角以闭式形式导出，从而使得规划永远不会要求跟踪器所拒绝的倾斜。对于运动仅被预测的障碍物，通过保形预测半径对障碍物进行膨胀，该半径以规定概率界定预测误差。在MuJoCo中，考虑全向轮滚子接触和扭矩饱和，该方案保持至少$10$\,cm的间隙，以$2$\,cm的RMS误差跟踪规划轨迹，将倾角保持在限制以下，并在$9$--$12$\,ms内完成规划，比进入膨胀障碍物的全模型非线性MPC快$10$--$15$倍；对于预测障碍物，保形膨胀在$30$个随机交叉场景中消除了恒速预测器的碰撞，并在闭合路径上的无限运行中减少了碰撞。源代码和视频演示可在https://safe-ballbot.github.io获取。

title: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
summary: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.
tldr: MoSoLoco improves monocular 3D human localization by reusing pose detector's internal visual features and incorporating sparse social context, achieving better accuracy for robot navigation and downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: MoSoLoco通过重用姿态检测器的内部视觉特征并结合稀疏社交上下文，提高了单目3D人体定位精度，适用于机器人导航和下游任务。
summary_zh: 从单目相机估计行人的度量三维位置对于机器人导航和运动预测至关重要。基于姿态的轻量级定位器因其在紧凑的二维关键点上运行，对计算资源有限的机器人硬件具有吸引力。然而，它们通常会丢弃姿态估计器所计算的更丰富的视觉表征。我们提出了MoSoLoco，一种逐帧单目三维人体定位器，它将姿态检测器的内部视觉特征与检测到的二维骨架相结合，且无需额外的RGB或深度编码器。MoSoLoco还可以进一步引入稀疏的同帧多人上下文来优化个体位置估计。在JRDB和NuScenes上的实验表明，复用姿态检测器表征能够改善定位效果，相对于所评估的最强基于关键点的基线方法，将JRDB上的最佳误差降低了约23%。一个稀疏社交交互模块利用同一图像中的邻近检测结果进行进一步优化。受控的轨迹预测实验显示了下游任务的收益，同时完整流程仍适用于高效的Jetson AGX Xavier推理。

title: KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL
summary: Progress in robot learning, particularly physical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), is currently challenged by a limited availability of accessible, standardized benchmarks. While simulation-based MARL has produced remarkable emergent behaviors, from coordinated team play to complex tool use, translating these advances to physical systems remains difficult. A key barrier is infrastructural: physical platforms are often prohibitively expensive, require specialized facilities, or lack open mechanisms and designs for reproducibility. We introduce KlaskTron, an open-source, low-cost (<\$2500 USD), desktop-scale robotic testbed for adversarial MARL based on the dynamic tabletop game KLASK. The platform features dual CoreXY gantries with high-torque brushless motors, enabling the high-speed, precise manipulation required for competitive play.
