Crucially, we provide a complete ecosystem: hardware designs (CAD, BOM), a GPU-native digital twin in NVIDIA Isaac Lab for high-fidelity modeling and simulation, and a validated sim-to-real baseline using a learned neural actuator model. We demonstrate that this baseline enables zero-shot policy transfer, with trained agents exhibiting emergent adversarial behaviors. To ensure full reproducibility of our results, all project assets are released publicly: hardware CAD/BOM and assembly documentation at [https://idscethzurich.github.io/klask_hardware], inference software stack at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_software] and the simulation and MARL setup at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_rl].
tldr: KlaskTron is an open-source, low-cost robotic testbed for adversarial multi-agent RL based on the game KLASK, featuring a digital twin in Isaac Lab and a validated sim-to-real baseline with zero-shot policy transfer.
tldr_zh: KlaskTron 是一个基于 KLASK 游戏的开源低成本对抗性多智能体强化学习机器人测试平台，提供 Isaac Lab 数字孪生和经过验证的 sim-to-real 基线，实现零样本策略迁移。
summary_zh: 机器人学习领域，特别是物理多智能体强化学习（MARL）的进展，目前受到可用、标准化基准测试稀缺的制约。尽管基于仿真的MARL已产生显著涌现行为，从协调团队配合到复杂工具使用，但这些进展向物理系统的迁移仍面临困难。一个关键障碍在于基础设施层面：物理平台往往成本过高、需要专门设施，或缺乏开放的机制设计和可复现性方案。我们推出KlaskTron——一个开源、低成本（低于2500美元）、桌面级的机器人测试平台，基于动态桌面游戏KLASK，专用于对抗性MARL研究。该平台配备双CoreXY龙门架及高扭矩无刷电机，能够实现竞技对抗所需的高速、精准操控。尤为重要的是，我们提供了完整的生态系统：硬件设计（CAD、BOM）、基于NVIDIA Isaac Lab构建的GPU原生数字孪生，用于高保真建模与仿真，以及利用学习得到的神经执行器模型验证的仿真到现实迁移基线。我们证明，该基线能够实现零样本策略迁移，训练出的智能体表现出涌现性对抗行为。为确保结果的可完全复现性，所有项目资源均公开发布：硬件CAD/BOM和装配文档见[https://idscethzurich.github.io/klask_hardware]，推理软件栈见[https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_software]，仿真和MARL设置见[https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_rl]。

title: KlaskTron-IL: A Contact-Rich Adversarial Imitation Learning Benchmark with a Validated Sim-to-Real Bridge
summary: KlaskTron is an open-hardware physical platform for two-player adversarial reinforcement learning, with a learned actuator model that supports zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of trained policies. Building on this platform, we contribute KlaskTron-IL: a multi-tier imitation learning dataset (80k human demonstration timesteps collected directly on the physical robot, 320k symmetry-augmented timesteps, and synthetic expert trajectories up to 5M steps generated by the zero-shot-validated PPO policy), and diagnostic baselines that expose three characteristic failure modes of standard IL methods under contact-rich adversarial dynamics: BC's data scaling plateau, GAIL's interpretable but weak-gradient discriminator (Spearman $ρ= -1.0$ peg-ball proximity recovery, but a logit span under 0.1), and an asymmetric BC-prior x reward-density interaction. Because the policy interface used throughout this paper is the same one the actuator model bridges to hardware, a policy trained on this benchmark can run unchanged on the physical robot, as we demonstrate zero-shot for the strongest BC baseline, so long as its commands respect the actuator model's $\pm 0.2$ m/s identification range.
tldr: KlaskTron-IL introduces a multi-tier imitation learning benchmark for contact-rich adversarial physical tasks, with a validated sim-to-real bridge via a learned actuator model. Diagnostic baselines expose characteristic failure modes of IL methods, and a trained policy is demonstrated zero-shot on the physical robot.
tldr_zh: KlaskTron-IL 为接触丰富的对抗性物理任务引入了一个多层级模仿学习基准，并通过学习到的执行器模型验证了仿真到现实的迁移桥梁。诊断基线揭示了 IL 方法的典型失败模式，并展示了在实体机器人上零样本部署的策略。
summary_zh: KlaskTron是一个面向双人对抗性强化学习的开源硬件物理平台，其学习到的执行器模型支持训练策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移。在此平台基础上，我们贡献了KlaskTron-IL：一个多层级模仿学习数据集（直接在物理机器人上采集的8万个人类演示时间步、32万个对称增强时间步，以及由经零样本验证的PPO策略生成的最多500万步的合成专家轨迹），以及诊断基线，揭示了标准模仿学习方法在接触丰富的对抗动力学下三种特征性失败模式：行为克隆的数据扩展平台期、GAIL可解释但梯度弱的判别器（Spearman ρ = -1.0的球-杆接近恢复，但logit跨度低于0.1），以及非对称的BC先验×奖励密度交互。由于本文贯穿使用的策略接口与执行器模型桥接到硬件的接口相同，在此基准上训练的策略可以不经修改地在物理机器人上运行，我们针对最强的BC基线展示了零样本迁移，前提是其指令遵守执行器模型的±0.2 m/s辨识范围。

title: BeyondContact: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Airflow-Based Non-Contact Manipulation
summary: Contact-based robotic manipulation is constrained by end-effector reachability and the mechanical properties of objects. Airflow can exert forces without direct robot-object contact, enabling manipulation of objects beyond the reach or when direct contact is undesirable. However, the lack of suitable simulation has hindered the application of reinforcement learning to airflow-based manipulation, limiting the broader adoption of this mechanism compared with contact-based methods. To address this gap, we developed a robot- and task-agnostic airflow extension for Isaac Lab that supports massively parallel training. The extension uses experimentally identified airflow models to compute the forces and torques exerted on objects. Based on this extension, we train a hybrid push-blow (HPB) policy that combines contact-based pushing with airflow manipulation and a rectangular reorientation (RR) policy that controls a cuboid's heading using airflow alone. To enable physical execution, we design a lightweight, high-speed blower that coexists with a gripper. In zero-shot real-world deployment, HPB achieves an 80% success rate over 20 trials, while RR achieves a mean absolute heading error of 2.6 degrees across four target headings. The project materials are available at https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/BeyondContact.
tldr: The paper introduces an airflow simulation extension for Isaac Lab and reinforcement learning policies (hybrid push-blow, rectangular reorientation) for non-contact manipulation, achieving zero-shot real-world deployment with a custom blower-gripper setup.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于Isaac Lab的气流模拟扩展及强化学习策略（混合推-吹、矩形重定向），实现非接触式操作，并在真实世界中零样本部署，使用定制吹风机-夹爪装置。
summary_zh: 基于接触的机器人操纵受限于末端执行器的可达范围和物体的机械属性。气流能够在无需机器人与物体直接接触的情况下施加力，从而实现对超出可达范围或不宜直接接触的物体的操纵。然而，缺乏合适的仿真环境阻碍了强化学习在基于气流的操纵中的应用，与基于接触的方法相比，这限制了该机制的更广泛采用。为弥补这一不足，我们为Isaac Lab开发了一个与机器人和任务无关的气流扩展模块，支持大规模并行训练。该扩展模块利用实验辨识的气流模型来计算作用于物体上的力和力矩。基于此扩展模块，我们训练了一种混合推吹策略，该策略结合了基于接触的推动与气流操纵，以及一种矩形重定向策略，该策略仅利用气流来控制长方体的朝向。为实现物理执行，我们设计了一种与夹爪共存的轻量级高速鼓风机。在零样本真实世界部署中，推吹策略在20次试验中实现了80%的成功率，而重定向策略在四个目标朝向上的平均绝对朝向误差为2.6度。项目材料可在https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/BeyondContact获取。

title: SyncHeC: Markerless Spatio-Temporal Hand-Eye Calibration via Differentiable Rendering and Continuous-Time Joint Optimization
summary: Markerless hand-eye calibration under continuous motion requires jointly resolving camera geometry and the time offset between images and joint states. We present SyncHeC (Synchronized Hand-Eye Calibration), a dense differentiable-rendering framework that estimates both from a single robot trajectory. Continuous-time forward kinematics makes latency differentiable, metric depth complements mask contours, and an offline planner combines spatial sensitivity with temporal excitation. Alternating updates support Eye-to-Hand, Eye-in-Hand, and multi-camera calibration. On a 7-DoF arm, one $6.5$\,s motion yields $0.21$\,cm translation error against a marker-board reference, $0.34$\,cm touch-test error, and $2.7$\,ms latency error relative to an $87$\,ms reference with $95\%$ uncertainty of $\pm1.5$\,ms. Against CM-Calib on matched recordings, translation and nominal latency errors improve by $3.7\times$ and $2.3\times$. Experiments span seven arms and four depth sensors. Compensating the recovered offset during policy training and deployment increases success by $8.1$ percentage points across six families and six tasks ($1{,}800$ matched pairs; paired $95\%$ confidence interval $[6.3,9.9]$ points).
tldr: SyncHeC is a markerless, continuous-time hand-eye calibration framework using differentiable rendering that jointly estimates camera geometry and image-joint latency; it improves policy success by 8.1 points on a 7-DoF arm.
tldr_zh: SyncHeC 是一种无需标记的连续时间手眼标定框架，利用可微渲染联合估计相机几何与图像-关节延迟，在 7 自由度机械臂上使策略成功率提升 8.1 个百分点。
summary_zh: 连续运动下的无标记手眼标定需要同时求解相机几何参数以及图像与关节状态之间的时间偏移。我们提出了SyncHeC（同步手眼标定），一种稠密可微渲染框架，可从单条机器人轨迹中同时估计以上两者。连续时间正向运动学使延迟可微，度量深度补充掩膜轮廓信息，离线规划器则兼顾空间敏感性与时间激励。交替更新支持眼对手、眼在手及多相机标定方式。在七自由度机械臂上，一次6.5秒的运动相对于标定板参考实现了0.21厘米的平移误差、0.34厘米的接触测试误差，以及相对于87毫秒参考值、95%不确定性为±1.5毫秒的2.7毫秒延迟误差。在与CM-Calib在匹配记录上的对比中，平移误差和标称延迟误差分别提升了3.7倍和2.3倍。实验覆盖七种机械臂和四种深度传感器。在策略训练与部署过程中补偿所恢复的时间偏移，在六个任务族和六项任务中使成功率平均提升8.1个百分点（1800对匹配样本；配对95%置信区间为[6.3, 9.9]个百分点）。

title: MS-DOTT: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Off-Road Traversability Estimation
summary: Autonomous robots are gaining traction in off-road environments, driven by their rising demand in agriculture, defense, and search-and-rescue operations. However, these environments are inherently unpredictable and navigation remains a formidable challenge given the complex environmental conditions including challenging terrain and varying illumination. Off-road autonomy requires robust perception across multiple spatial scales and imaging modalities, yet most sensing setups struggle to capture both far-field environmental context and near-field terrain detail simultaneously across various illumination conditions. To facilitate development of robust off-road perception and traversability estimation systems, we propose MS-DOTT (Multi-Sensor Dataset for Off-road Terrain Traversability) a comprehensive multi-modal off-road dataset with long-range 3D sensing and short-range, fine-grained perception to facilitate high-fidelity terrain understanding by combining proprioceptive signals for tracking vehicle dynamics with exteroceptive imaging and pointcloud data. The dataset includes trajectories recorded across nominal lighting, low-light, and no-light conditions with diverse 2D and 3D sensing for both long-range large-scale and short-range high-resolution sensing, as well as 4D RADAR measurements that provide velocity estimates for detected pointclouds. We demonstrate the utility of the dataset by adapting a SOTA multi-sensor fusion method for the purpose of traversability estimation. This dataset will aid the robotics community in advancing research and development of methods for traversability estimation, off-road perception and multi-sensor fusion in unstructured environments.
tldr: The paper introduces MS-DOTT, a multi-modal dataset for off-road traversability estimation with long-range 3D and short-range fine-grained sensing across lighting conditions, and demonstrates its utility by adapting a SOTA multi-sensor fusion method.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了MS-DOTT，一个用于越野可通行性估计的多模态数据集，包含远距离3D和短距离精细感知，涵盖多种光照条件，并通过适配先进的的多传感器融合方法展示了其效用。
summary_zh: 自主机器人在越野环境中的应用正日益受到关注，这得益于其在农业、国防以及搜索与救援任务中不断增长的需求。然而，这些环境本质上具有不可预测性，加之复杂的环境条件（如艰难的地形和多变的照明），导航仍然是一项严峻的挑战。越野自主性要求具备跨多种空间尺度和成像模态的稳健感知能力，然而大多数传感设备难以同时在不同光照条件下捕捉远场环境背景和近场地形细节。为促进稳健的越野感知和可通行性估计系统的发展，我们提出了MS-DOTT（越野地形可通行性多传感器数据集）——一个全面的多模态越野数据集，结合了远距离3D感知和近距离精细感知，通过将本体感觉信号用于跟踪车辆动力学，并与外部成像和点云数据相融合，从而实现高保真地形理解。该数据集包含在标称光照、低光照和无光照条件下记录的轨迹，涵盖用于远距离大规模和近距离高分辨率感知的多种2D和3D传感技术，以及提供检测点云速度估计的4D雷达测量。我们通过采用一种最先进的多传感器融合方法进行可通行性估计，展示了该数据集的实用性。该数据集将有助于机器人社区推动在非结构化环境中可通行性估计、越野感知和多传感器融合方法的研究与开发。

title: Positive Safety Margins from Artificial Potential Field Reward Augmentation for Size-Robust Obstacle Avoidance under Partial Observability
summary: Collision-free reaching is central to manipulation, yet real cells often leave the size and exact position of an obstacle unobserved, which excludes reinforcement learning controllers that take obstacle geometry as input. A reward limited to a collision penalty does not depend on the clearance outside the obstacle, so under a step cost its learned policy skims the obstacle surface and fails once the obstacle radius exceeds its training value. We investigate whether a single analytic reward term can induce a safety margin without exposing the obstacle to the policy. We augment the reward of a simulated Franka Emika Panda reaching task with a horizontal artificial potential field that penalizes proximity within a safety margin around each of two pillars (fixed nominal layout, random drift). Under hidden observation, policies trained with this term maintain a safe success rate above 88% across a radius sweep from 0.03 m to 0.055 m (30 seeds), while policies without it fall below 10% at the maximum tested radius; the term induces a minimum clearance of 47.9 mm against 9.6 mm without it and eliminates training collisions at least eight times earlier (median steps). The advantage is statistically significant at all out-of-distribution radii and holds across three reinforcement learning solvers and under full observation. Its safe success rate is comparable to that of a classical potential-field planner given the pillar positions. The margin is a fixed buffer rather than an adaptation to the radius, and it lengthens the path by about 19%.
tldr: This paper introduces a reward augmentation term based on an artificial potential field to induce safety margins in reinforcement learning for obstacle avoidance in a Franka Emika Panda reaching task, improving robustness to obstacle size variations under partial observability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于人工势场的奖励增强项，在Franka Emika Panda到达任务中诱导安全裕度，提高了部分可观测下对障碍物尺寸变化的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 无碰撞到达是操控的核心任务，然而真实细胞环境往往使障碍物的大小和精确位置无法被观测到，这使得依赖障碍物几何信息作为输入的强化学习控制器无法应用。若奖励仅包含碰撞惩罚，则其并不依赖于障碍物外部的净空距离，因此在阶跃成本的条件下，学习得到的策略会紧贴障碍物表面运动，一旦障碍物半径超出训练设定值便会失效。本文研究单一解析奖励项能否在不让策略获知障碍物信息的情况下引入安全裕度。我们在模拟的Franka Emika Panda到达任务中，在奖励中加入一个水平人工势场，用以在两个立柱（固定名义布局、随机漂移）安全裕度范围内对靠近行为施加惩罚。在隐藏观测条件下，加入该奖励项训练得到的策略，在半径从0.03 m到0.055 m的扫描范围内（30个随机种子）保持高于88%的安全成功率，而未加入该奖励项的策略在最大测试半径下安全成功率低于10%；该奖励项使最小净空距离达到47.9 mm，而无该奖励项时仅为9.6 mm，并在训练碰撞消除时间上至少提前八倍（中位步数）。在分布外全部半径条件下，该优势均具有统计学显著性，并且在三种强化学习求解器以及完全观测条件下同样成立。其安全成功率与在已知立柱位置条件下采用经典势场规划器时相当。该安全裕度是一个固定缓冲区，而非对半径的适应性调整，且会使路径长度增加约19%。

title: RESONATE: a Real Social Navigation Testbed for Autonomous Service Robots
summary: Social navigation is essential for autonomous service robots operating in human environments, but progress remains constrained by the lack of extensive real-world benchmarks. This paper presents the Real Social Navigation Testbed (RESONATE), a reproducible benchmark for human-aware navigation based on a unified robotic platform, a shared ROS 2 software stack, precise trajectory ground truth, and structured social interaction scenarios. We evaluate eight controller configurations, combining classical and predictive local planners with different social modeling strategies, over eight representative scenarios with five repetitions each, yielding 320 physical experiments. The benchmark combines quantitative navigation and social metrics with participant-based qualitative assessments to jointly measure efficiency, safety, comfort, and perceived social behavior. Results reveal scenario-dependent trade-offs among the tested methods. The algorithms that stands out for their performance are the DWA with Gaussian social costmaps for its reliability, and the SFM-MPPI to provide the best balance between robustness, navigation efficiency, and social acceptance. Overall, RESONATE supports the robotics community with a real-world benchmark, reusable baselines, data, and testbed, and a consistent evaluation protocol for advancing socially aware navigation research.
tldr: RESONATE introduces a reproducible real-world benchmark for social navigation with a unified ROS 2 stack, 320 physical experiments, and quantitative/qualitative metrics, evaluating eight controller configurations and revealing trade-offs among methods.
tldr_zh: RESONATE 提出了一个可复现的真实世界社交导航基准，基于统一的 ROS 2 软件栈、320 次物理实验和定量/定性指标，评估了八种控制器配置并揭示了方法间的权衡。
summary_zh: 社交导航对于在人类环境中运行的自主服务机器人至关重要，但相关进展仍因缺乏大规模真实世界基准而受到制约。本文介绍了真实社交导航测试平台（RESONATE），这是一个基于统一机器人平台、共享ROS 2软件栈、精确轨迹真值以及结构化社交互动场景的可复现人感知导航基准。我们评估了八种控制器配置，将经典与预测性局部规划器同不同的社交建模策略相结合，覆盖八个代表性场景，每个场景重复五次，共进行了320次物理实验。该基准将定量导航指标与社会指标同基于参与者的定性评估相结合，共同衡量效率、安全性、舒适度及感知到的社交行为。结果表明，各测试方法在不同场景下存在权衡取舍。其中表现突出的算法包括：采用高斯社交代价地图的DWA，因其可靠性优异；以及SFM-MPPI，其在鲁棒性、导航效率与社交接受度之间提供了最佳平衡。总体而言，RESONATE为机器人社区提供了一个真实世界基准、可复用的基线方法、数据与测试平台，以及一套统一的评估协议，以推动社交感知导航研究的进展。

title: AnchorHEC: Targetless Hand-Eye Calibration of Wrist and Fixed Cameras
summary: Recent robot systems combine wrist and fixed cameras, requiring camera-to-robot transforms for both. Most hand-eye calibration methods rely on targets or robot-body observations. Scene-based methods using 3D reconstruction require neither but address only wrist cameras. We introduce AnchorHEC, a targetless hand-eye calibration framework for wrist and fixed cameras in a single procedure using RGB images, forward kinematics (FK), and known camera intrinsics. We initialize both camera types using FK and a shared 3D foundation model reconstruction. FK-constrained wrist-image bundle adjustment reduces the impact of reconstructed pose and scale errors. If this refinement fails or retains too few inliers, we relax the constraints on potentially inaccurate FK poses and lens parameters. We use the refined wrist transform and FK to triangulate metric points and estimate fixed-camera poses. Across three backbones, calibration errors in simulation decrease by 86.4% in translation and 71.6% in rotation, averaged over both camera types, relative to reconstruction-based baselines. We also validate AnchorHEC on a physical robot. Project page: https://hwanggb.github.io/AnchorHEC/
tldr: AnchorHEC introduces a targetless hand-eye calibration framework using RGB images, forward kinematics, and a shared 3D foundation model reconstruction, jointly calibrating wrist and fixed cameras with enhanced accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: AnchorHEC 提出了一种无靶标的手眼标定框架，利用 RGB 图像、正向运动学和共享的 3D 基础模型重建，联合标定腕部相机和固定相机，提高了精度和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 近期机器人系统结合了腕部相机与固定相机，二者均需进行相机到机器人的变换。大多数手眼标定方法依赖标靶或机器人本体观测。基于场景的三维重建方法虽无需标靶或机器人本体观测，但仅适用于腕部相机。我们提出AnchorHEC，一种无标靶手眼标定框架，可在单一流程中同时标定腕部相机与固定相机，仅需RGB图像、正运动学（FK）及已知相机内参。我们利用FK和共享的三维基础模型重建对两种相机进行初始化。FK约束的腕部图像光束法平差降低了重建位姿与尺度误差的影响。若该优化失败或保留的内点过少，则放松对可能不准确的FK位姿和镜头参数的约束。我们利用优化后的腕部变换和FK三角化度量点，并估计固定相机位姿。在三种骨干网络上，相较于基于重建的基线方法，仿真中两种相机类型的平均标定误差在平移上降低86.4%，在旋转上降低71.6%。我们还在实体机器人上验证了AnchorHEC。项目主页：https://hwanggb.github.io/AnchorHEC/

title: SomaAlign: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Representation Learning for Soft Robotic Grasping
summary: Robust multimodal perception for soft robotic grasping is challenged by modality-dependent noise, semantic ambiguity, and limited coordinated multisensory data. We introduce Soma, a dataset containing 100 objects, 1,000 continuous grasping trajectories, and 74,914 multimodal samples grouped by software acquisition cycle, spanning remote RGB, hand RGB, depth, tactile, IMU, and structured text observations. We also collect Soma-Success, an independent grasp-outcome dataset with 1,000 trials (998 retained after quality control), to evaluate frozen-encoder transfer for post-hoc grasp outcome classification and early grasp success prediction. Built on Soma, SomaAlign learns multimodal representations in three stages: masked reconstruction estimates relative modality reliability; reliability-aware contrastive alignment uses pair-specific adaptive temperatures to adjust alignment sharpness; and conflict-aware semantic constraints improve intra-sample cross-modal consistency while preserving global feature geometry. SomaAlign achieves an average Recall@10 of 90.66% across 30 directed cross-modal retrieval tasks. The learned representations also support physical attribute recognition, multimodal question answering, cross-modal generation, and cross-dataset transfer to grasp outcome prediction. On Soma-Success, frozen SomaAlign encoders with lightweight probes achieve 94.59% post-hoc classification accuracy and 84.07% early prediction accuracy. Together, Soma, Soma-Success, and SomaAlign provide a data and representation-learning foundation for robust and transferable multimodal perception in soft robotic manipulation.
tldr: The paper introduces Soma, a large multimodal dataset for soft robotic grasping, and SomaAlign, a reliability-aware representation learning method that achieves strong performance in cross-modal retrieval and downstream grasp outcome prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于软体机器人抓取的大型多模态数据集Soma，以及一种可靠性感知的表征学习方法SomaAlign，在跨模态检索和抓取结果预测中取得了优异性能。
summary_zh: 面向软体机器人抓取的鲁棒多模态感知面临模态相关噪声、语义模糊以及协调多感官数据有限等挑战。我们提出了Soma，一个包含100个物体、1000条连续抓取轨迹和74914个多模态样本的数据集，样本按软件采集周期分组，涵盖远程RGB、手部RGB、深度、触觉、IMU和结构化文本观测。我们还采集了Soma-Success，一个独立的抓取结果数据集，包含1000次试验（质量控制后保留998次），用于评估冻结编码器迁移在事后抓取结果分类和早期抓取成功预测中的表现。基于Soma，SomaAlign分三个阶段学习多模态表示：掩码重建估计相对模态可靠性；可靠性感知对比对齐使用配对特定的自适应温度来调整对齐锐度；冲突感知语义约束在保持全局特征几何结构的同时提升样本内跨模态一致性。SomaAlign在30个有向跨模态检索任务中取得了90.66%的平均Recall@10。所学表示还支持物理属性识别、多模态问答、跨模态生成以及跨数据集迁移至抓取结果预测。在Soma-Success上，冻结的SomaAlign编码器配合轻量探针实现了94.59%的事后分类准确率和84.07%的早期预测准确率。Soma、Soma-Success和SomaAlign共同为软体机器人操作中鲁棒且可迁移的多模态感知提供了数据和表示学习基础。

title: Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up
summary: We reimplement the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) and test the uncertainty estimate that its follow-up, RWM-U, uses to penalize reward in offline policy optimization. Our implementation matches the released model's gradients. On held-out data, training on the model's own rollouts beats one-step training at the preregistered long horizon for all ten episodes, but loses on short one-step windows. RWM-U's ensemble disagreement ranks rollout errors better than forecast step (Spearman rho = 0.90 at 100 steps), yet its spread substantially understates error: one-sigma coverage on the released checkpoint is 4.6% at 100 steps, versus 68% for a calibrated Gaussian. Rolling ensemble members on their own predictions raises coverage to 33%. The implemented squared-error loss on sampled predictions drives each member's variance toward zero. A horizon-specific rescaling restores one-sigma coverage under leave-one-episode-out evaluation, but not two-sigma coverage. We also identify two defects in the released evaluation pipeline. The study covers one robot, one gait and one dataset; it trains no policy.
tldr: This paper reimplements the Robotic World Model's dynamics model and evaluates its uncertainty estimation, finding that ensemble disagreement ranks errors well but understates their magnitude, and proposing a horizon-specific rescaling to improve calibration.
tldr_zh: 本文重新实现了机器人世界模型的动力学模型，并评估其不确定性估计，发现集成分歧能很好地对误差排序但低估了误差大小，并提出了针对时间跨度的重标定以改善校准。
summary_zh: 我们重新实现了机器人世界模型（RWM）的动力学模型，并测试了其后续模型RWM-U在离线策略优化中用于惩罚奖励的不确定性估计。我们的实现与发布模型的梯度一致。在留出数据上，基于模型自身 rollout 的训练在预注册的长时域上十个回合均优于单步训练，但在短的单步窗口上表现较差。RWM-U 的集成不一致性在排序 rollout 误差方面优于预测步数（100 步时 Spearman rho = 0.90），但其离散度显著低估了误差：在发布的检查点上，100 步时的一西格玛覆盖率为 4.6%，而校准高斯分布为 68%。将集成成员基于自身预测进行滚动更新可将覆盖率提升至 33%。对采样预测实施的平方误差损失使得每个成员的方差趋近于零。在留一回合评估下，针对特定时域的重新缩放可将一西格玛覆盖率恢复，但无法恢复二西格玛覆盖率。我们还发现了已发布评估流程中的两个缺陷。本研究覆盖一个机器人、一种步态和一个数据集；未训练任何策略。

title: Neural Integral Control Barrier Functions for Agile Collision Avoidance
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) are a standard way to keep a planner inside a safe set, but they assume control affine dynamics, a barrier function given in closed form, and a known nominal controller. Integral control barrier functions (ICBFs) remove the first assumption and absorb input constraints, yet they still assume a given nominal controller and a barrier function. In this work, we present an approach to learn all three from data, using neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for the dynamics, imitation for the nominal controller, and supervised regression for the barrier function. The learned dynamics, nominal controller, and the barrier function are used to build the ICBF filter constraint analytically. Furthermore, the barrier is trained on viability rather than geometry, meaning that a state counts as safe only if some emergency maneuver can still avoid the constraint under the actuator limits, a correction that geometric labels miss entirely and that grows with speed. Actuator limits then enter the online program as hard bounds while the learned barrier rows may be relaxed, which keeps the program solvable at every state and the actuator limits exact, and we bound how far the input it returns can drift from the one the true models would give. On agile racing with a 6-D dynamic bicycle, the filter removes all 12 unsafe episodes from 200 held out layouts at an unchanged success rate and above 100 Hz on one CPU core, holds the input constraint on every episode of a benchmark where a jointly trained baseline holds it on 53.38%, and keeps that advantage under large errors in the plant friction.
tldr: This paper learns neural ODE dynamics, a nominal controller via imitation, and a viability-based barrier function to build integral control barrier function filters for agile collision avoidance, achieving safe racing on a 6-D dynamic bicycle.
tldr_zh: 本文通过神经ODE学习动力学、模仿学习标称控制器以及基于可行性的障碍函数，构建积分控制障碍函数滤波器，在6维动态自行车模型上实现敏捷避撞 racing。
summary_zh: 控制障碍函数（CBFs）是使规划器保持在安全集内的标准方法，但其假设控制仿射动力学、以闭式形式给出的障碍函数以及已知的标称控制器。积分控制障碍函数（ICBFs）去除了第一个假设并吸收了输入约束，但仍假设给定标称控制器和障碍函数。在本工作中，我们提出了一种从数据中学习这三者的方法：使用神经常微分方程（ODEs）学习动力学，使用模仿学习获得标称控制器，使用监督回归学习障碍函数。学习到的动力学、标称控制器和障碍函数被用于解析地构建ICBF滤波约束。此外，障碍函数基于可行性而非几何形状进行训练，这意味着只有当某种紧急机动仍能在执行器限制下避开约束时，该状态才被视为安全——这一修正完全被几何标签所遗漏，且随速度增长而愈发重要。执行器限制随后以硬边界的形式进入在线规划程序，而学习到的障碍行则可以放松，这使得规划程序在每个状态下均可求解且执行器限制保持精确，我们还界定了其返回的输入与真实模型所给出的输入之间可能偏离的程度。在6维动态自行车的敏捷竞速任务中，该滤波器在200个留出布局中以不变的成功率和单CPU核心上超过100 Hz的频率消除了全部12次不安全事件，在基准测试的每个回合中都保持了输入约束——而联合训练的基线仅在53.38%的回合中保持该约束——并在被控对象摩擦存在大误差时仍保持该优势。

title: MAPO: Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization for Universal Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Universal humanoid motion tracking is essential for enabling humanoid robots to perform diverse tasks in human environments. To capture the wide diversity of human motions, mixture-of-experts (MoE) policies have been widely adopted, leveraging dynamic routing to enhance policy expressiveness. However, we identify that divergence between old and updated policies can be misestimated during policy-gradient updates of MoE policies, due to their dynamic routing. Because most policy-gradient algorithms regulate policy updates based on the divergence, this misestimation can lead to either overly conservative or excessively large updates, which can yield a suboptimal policy. In this paper, we propose Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization (MAPO), which alternately optimizes the router and the experts to avoid the divergence misestimation. MAPO consistently tracks 182 motions that PPO with MoE fails to track, whereas PPO with MoE tracks only one motion that MAPO fails to track. MAPO also attains the highest tracking success rate among the compared methods and the lowest tracking error across most error metrics, demonstrating its superior performance. Videos can be found on the project website: https://mapo-corl2026.github.io/MAPO/
tldr: MAPO introduces alternating optimization of router and experts in mixture-of-experts policies to fix divergence misestimation in policy-gradient updates, achieving higher success rates in humanoid motion tracking.
tldr_zh: MAPO 通过交替优化专家混合策略中的路由器和专家，避免了策略梯度更新中的散度误估计，从而在类人运动跟踪中取得了更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 通用人形运动追踪对于使人形机器人在人类环境中执行多样化任务至关重要。为捕捉人类运动的广泛多样性，混合专家（MoE）策略已被广泛采用，其利用动态路由机制来增强策略的表达能力。然而，我们发现，在MoE策略的策略梯度更新过程中，由于动态路由机制的存在，旧策略与更新后策略之间的散度可能被错误估计。由于大多数策略梯度算法基于该散度来调节策略更新幅度，这种误估计可能导致更新过于保守或过于激进，从而产生次优策略。为此，本文提出了一种名为“交替策略优化的混合专家模型”（MAPO）的方法，通过交替优化路由器和专家网络来避免散度误估计问题。实验结果表明，MAPO能够持续追踪182个动作，而采用MoE的PPO算法无法追踪这些动作；相比之下，采用MoE的PPO算法仅能追踪一个MAPO无法追踪的动作。此外，MAPO在对比方法中取得了最高的追踪成功率，并在大多数误差指标上实现了最低的追踪误差，展现了其优越的性能。相关视频可在项目网站上查看：https://mapo-corl2026.github.io/MAPO/

title: Central pivot point control of a body-attached spring-mass runner: periodic gaits, stabilization, template embedding and approximate analytic return maps
summary: The spring-loaded inverted pendulum (SLIP) describes the center-of-mass (COM) motion of runners but has no trunk. In trunk models, the hip torque couples posture and COM motion and destroys the central-force structure on which SLIP analysis relies. As a result, trunk models have been studied almost only numerically. We show that this structure can be restored. The central pivot point (CPP), a hip-torque law that directs the ground reaction force through the COM, decouples pitch exactly and reduces stance to a planar central-force problem. At upright posture, time-reversal symmetry produces one-parameter families of periodic gaits. A stance-phase pitch law and a stride-level regulator stabilize all computed gaits, also with bounded hip torque and friction. Under CPP, any radial force law in virtual-leg coordinates can be embedded independently of posture. For a linear radial template, the stance radius and the constant-momentum sweep have exact closed forms. With a new gravity correction, the resulting analytic return map, to our knowledge the first for a trunk model, predicts liftoff velocity and apex position with mean errors of 1.6% and 0.9%. The natural gaits of the embedded runner are symmetric and need no force step at touchdown. A near-reversibility argument explains their unit multiplier, and a scalar equation predicts them within 0.8%. A deadbeat stride controller based on the analytic map tracks changes of speed, height and posture. CPP thus makes trunk models accessible to the analytic tools developed for SLIP.
tldr: This paper introduces a hip-torque law, the central pivot point (CPP), that restores the central-force structure of the SLIP model for trunked runners, enabling analytic analysis and control of periodic gaits.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种髋部力矩定律（中心枢轴点，CPP），恢复了带躯干跑步者SLIP模型的中心力结构，从而实现了对周期步态的解析分析和控制。
summary_zh: 弹簧加载倒立摆（SLIP）描述了跑步者的质心（COM）运动，但未包含躯干。在躯干模型中，髋关节力矩将姿态与质心运动耦合，并破坏了SLIP分析所依赖的中心力结构。因此，躯干模型几乎只能通过数值方法进行研究。我们证明该结构可以被恢复。中心枢轴点（CPP）是一种髋关节力矩律，它将地面反作用力引导通过质心，从而精确解耦俯仰运动，并将支撑相简化为平面中心力问题。在直立姿态下，时间反演对称性产生单参数族的周期步态。支撑相俯仰律和步幅级调节器可稳定所有计算得到的步态，同时髋关节力矩和摩擦力均有界。在CPP下，虚拟腿坐标中的任意径向力律均可独立于姿态嵌入。对于线性径向模板，支撑半径和恒定动量扫掠具有精确的闭式解。借助新的重力修正，所得到的解析返回映射——据我们所知，这是首个针对躯干模型的解析返回映射——预测离地速度和顶点位置的平均误差分别为1.6%和0.9%。嵌入式跑步者的自然步态是对称的，且在触地时无需力的阶跃。近可逆性论证解释了其单位乘子，一个标量方程可在0.8%的误差内预测这些步态。基于解析映射的无超调步幅控制器可跟踪速度、高度和姿态的变化。因此，CPP使躯干模型能够利用为SLIP开发的解析工具进行分析。

title: Neuro Inspired Robotics: What Robot Learning Can Borrow from the Sensorimotor Brain
summary: Robot policies still fail at everyday manipulation: an unfamiliar task, an object never held before, a scene that changes mid-motion, a skill that should improve with use. They fail despite pretraining on over a million trajectories, pooled from dozens of robots at great expense, while a child acquires all of these abilities within a few years of learning from a single body. This survey argues that the gap is one of design, and proposes designs for the next generation of robot models, drawn from how the nervous system solves the same problems. From the body we take compliance: the policy commands stiffness alongside position, so the controller yields where the task allows and presses where it must, which greatly lowers the demand for precise position output. From the visual system, where a fast pathway for action runs in parallel with the slow pathway for recognition, we take a dedicated fast vision system for motor behavior: it precomputes the quantities the policy needs and drives a reactive policy at camera rate. From the cerebellum we take a predictor beside the policy that forecasts the consequence of each command and recalibrates from its own error. From motor cortex we take a single model that composes action units from primitives, verifies each at a sensory boundary, practices the weakest unit with a hypothesis in mind, and reasons each attempt closer to the goal. Proven primitives are then consolidated from code into weights, so they run fluently and respond quickly the next time. Together these describe a robot that acts on its own initiative, the basis of deployment and recursive self-improvement, and we offer each proposal as a hypothesis to be tested.
tldr: This survey proposes bio-inspired design principles from the sensorimotor brain—compliance, fast vision pathways, cerebellar predictors, motor primitives, and consolidation—to build the next generation of robot policies.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述提出从感觉运动大脑借鉴设计原则——柔顺控制、快速视觉通路、小脑预测器、运动基元和固化——以构建下一代机器人策略。
summary_zh: 机器人策略在日常操作任务中仍然频频失败：面对一个不熟悉的任务、一个从未持握过的物体、一个在运动过程中发生变化的环境、一项本应随着使用而提升的技能，它们都会失败。尽管这些策略已在超过一百万条轨迹上进行了预训练——这些轨迹以高昂代价从数十台机器人上汇集而来——但一个孩子仅凭单一身体，在学习几年之内就能获得上述全部能力。本综述认为，这一差距本质上是设计层面的差距，并从神经系统解决同类问题的方式中汲取灵感，为下一代机器人模型提出设计方案。从身体层面，我们引入柔顺性：策略在输出位置的同时输出刚度，使控制器在任务允许之处让步、在必须之处施力，从而大幅降低对精确位置输出的需求。从视觉系统层面，其中一条快速通路并行于慢速识别通路专门服务于动作，我们引入一个专门的快速视觉系统来支持运动行为：它预先计算策略所需的各项量，并以相机帧率驱动一个反应式策略。从小脑层面，我们在策略旁边引入一个预测器，用于预估每条指令的后果，并根据自身误差进行重新校准。从运动皮层层面，我们引入一个单一模型，它从基元组合出动作单元，在感觉边界处逐一验证每个单元，带着假设练习最薄弱的单元，并逐步推理使每次尝试更接近目标。经过验证的基元随后从代码固化为权重，使其下次运行时流畅且响应迅速。这些设计共同描绘了一个能够自主发起行动的机器人，这是部署与递归自我改进的基础。我们将每一项提议作为待检验的假设提出。

title: Human Sensorimotor Model Adaptation to Account for Robot Accuracy and Speed Augmentation in Human-Robot Co-Manipulation
summary: In human-robot co-manipulation, the robot's trajectory should accommodate the human's, where human sensorimotor behavior is affected by the task's spatial and temporal constraints, as well as personal factors. Several robot trajectory planning methods have been proposed to embed human sensorimotor models in the robot trajectory planning, but these methods do not consider temporal constraints that adapt to how the human behaves when interacting with the robot. To better align human and robot collaborative motion, this work adapts a stochastic optimal control problem with a final state constraint from the task constraints and a temporal constraint from Fitts' law. A recursive least squares method is used to estimate the Fitts' law parameters, adapting the robot's motion duration to that of the human, thus allowing the robot to adapt to how the human behaves when interacting with the robot. It is hypothesized that a speed increase can result from the robot augmenting the accuracy. The feasibility of the approach is validated on a positioning task where the robot controls degrees of freedom which have repeatable motion, and the human adapts motion in the complementary degrees of freedom. The approach is shown to be computationally suited to online use, it converges as the human and robot mutually adapt, and can increase the movement speed, although thorough human studies are needed in future work.
tldr: This work adapts a human sensorimotor model using Fitts' law and recursive least squares to plan robot trajectories that accommodate human temporal behavior in co-manipulation, validating feasibility on a positioning task.
tldr_zh: 该工作利用菲茨定律和递归最小二乘法自适应人类感觉运动模型，为机器人规划能适应人类时间行为的协同操作轨迹，并在定位任务上验证了可行性。
summary_zh: 在人机协同操作中，机器人的轨迹应当适应人类的轨迹，而人类的感觉运动行为受到任务的空间和时间约束以及个人因素的影响。目前已有多项机器人轨迹规划方法被提出，旨在将人类感觉运动模型嵌入机器人轨迹规划中，但这些方法未考虑适应人类在与机器人交互时行为方式的时间约束。为更好地协调人与机器人的协作运动，本研究将任务约束中的终端状态约束与菲茨定律中的时间约束相结合，构建了一个随机最优控制问题。采用递归最小二乘法估计菲茨定律参数，使机器人的运动时长适应人类的运动时长，从而使机器人能够适应人类在与机器人交互时的行为方式。研究假设机器人通过提高精度可以带来速度的提升。该方法在一个定位任务上得到了可行性验证，其中机器人控制具有可重复运动的自由度，人类则在互补自由度中调整运动。结果表明，该方法在计算上适合在线使用，随着人与机器人的相互适应而收敛，并能够提高运动速度，但未来仍需开展全面的人因研究。

title: VagueBench: Benchmarking the Robustness of Embodied Agents on Ambient Context Illusions
summary: Embodied agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments, yet current robustness evaluations remain biased toward hazardous instructions and jailbreak vulnerabilities. A more fundamental issue is largely overlooked: agents are rarely tested under semantically sufficient but contextually minimal instructions (i.e., common in real-world human communication), where auxiliary contextual cues are absent. For the first, we identify a novel phenomenon termed Ambient Context Illusion, where agents fail to execute tasks correctly when non-essential contextual details are omitted, despite unchanged task semantics. To systematically study this, we establish VagueBench, a benchmark built upon the AI2-THOR interactive simulation environment for the evaluation of context dependency in embodied agents. We systematically consider key semantic components of instructions (entities, procedures, constraints, and prior knowledge) and derive a unified taxonomy with four categories and nine subtypes to reduce auxiliary information. VagueBench contains 1,303 instruction pairs across diverse indoor environments, constructed via a human-agent co-generation framework that integrates semantic redundancy estimation, taxonomy-guided transformation, and rigorous semantic-invariance verification. Through extensive evaluation on 6 state-of-the-art embodied agents, we observe significant degradation on VagueBench in both task performance and executability (relatively -19.65% in task success rate and relatively +54.10% in empty plan rate) revealing a strong reliance on auxiliary linguistic signals rather than core task semantics. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this phenomenon persists in real-world robotic systems, where it can lead to incorrect decisions and potential safety risks.
tldr: This paper introduces VagueBench, a benchmark based on AI2-THOR to evaluate embodied agents' robustness to 'Ambient Context Illusion'—task failures caused by omitted non-essential contextual details despite unchanged task semantics. Experiments on six embodied agents show significant performance degradation, highlighting a reliance on auxiliary linguistic signals rather than core task semantics, with extensions to real-world robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了基于AI2-THOR的基准VagueBench，用于评估具身智能体对“环境上下文错觉”的鲁棒性，即当非必要上下文细节被省略但任务语义不变时，智能体表现显著下降，并扩展到真实机器人系统。
summary_zh: 具身智能体正日益部署于开放世界环境中，然而现有的鲁棒性评估仍偏向于危险指令与越狱漏洞的检测。一个更为根本的问题在很大程度上被忽视：智能体很少在语义充分但上下文极简的指令（即人类真实交流中的常见情形）下接受测试，此时缺乏辅助性语境线索。我们首次识别出一种新现象，称之为“环境上下文错觉”（Ambient Context Illusion），即当非必要的上下文细节被省略时，尽管任务语义保持不变，智能体仍无法正确执行任务。为系统研究该现象，我们构建了VagueBench基准，该基准基于AI2-THOR交互式模拟环境，用于评估具身智能体的上下文依赖性。我们系统性地考察了指令的关键语义成分（实体、流程、约束与先验知识），并推导出包含四个类别和九个子类型的统一分类体系，以减少辅助信息。VagueBench包含覆盖多种室内环境的1，303对指令，通过人机协同生成框架构建，该框架集成了语义冗余估计、分类体系引导的转换以及严格的语义不变性验证。通过对6种最先进的具身智能体进行广泛评估，我们观察到其在VagueBench上的任务性能和可执行性均显著下降（任务成功率相对下降19.65%，空规划率相对上升54.10%），揭示出智能体对辅助语言信号而非核心任务语义的强烈依赖。此外，我们证明该现象在真实世界机器人系统中同样存在，可能导致错误决策及潜在安全风险。

title: AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds
summary: Recent interactive video world models generate visually compelling videos from a single image, following user-provided camera motion and text prompts. However, such low-level control demands substantial user effort to realize a high-level intent, and the generated world struggles to remain persistent as the exploration proceeds. In this work, we present AgiWorld, an agentic video world model that explores and builds a persistent world from a single image and a free-form instruction. For high-level planning, our agent AgiWorld-Agent designs the world and the journey through it in a world state and directs the exploration. For low-level realization, our video world model AgiWorld-WM generates the video chunk by chunk and stores it with its geometry in a spatial memory, from which the agent updates its world state. This closed loop keeps the world faithful to the user's intent and keeps the agent's world state consistent with the generated content throughout the exploration. We co-design the two levels around the shared spatial memory and an interface of metric camera trajectories and structured prompts. In AgiWorld-WM, to handle occlusion and accumulated geometric errors in the spatial memory over long rollouts, we propose occlusion-aware history selection, which retrieves past views by surface visibility, and reliability-based memory maintenance, which prefers reliable geometry and earlier observations. AgiWorld-WM achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on world revisiting and exploration benchmarks, and qualitative results and ablations show that AgiWorld builds persistent worlds from free-form instructions over minute-long journeys. Persistence thus arises not from the video model alone but from its closed loop with the agent.
tldr: AgiWorld introduces an agentic video world model that builds persistent virtual worlds from a single image and free-form instructions through a closed-loop agent-video model interaction with spatial memory and geometry-aware history management.
tldr_zh: AgiWorld提出了一种智能体视频世界模型，通过智能体与视频模型的闭环交互，从单一图像和自由形式指令构建持久虚拟世界，并利用空间记忆和几何感知的历史管理保持一致性。
summary_zh: 近期开发的交互式视频世界模型，能够根据用户提供的相机运动轨迹和文本提示，从单张图像生成视觉上令人信服的视频。然而，这种低层次的控制方式需要用户付出大量努力才能实现高层次的意图，且生成的世界在探索过程中难以保持连贯性。在本研究中，我们提出了AgiWorld，一个智能体视频世界模型，它能够从单张图像和自由形式的指令出发，探索并构建一个持久的世界。在高层次规划方面，我们的智能体AgiWorld-Agent在世界状态下设计世界及其探索路径，并引导探索过程。在低层次实现方面，我们的视频世界模型AgiWorld-WM逐段生成视频，并将其与几何信息一同存储在空间记忆中，智能体据此更新其世界状态。这一闭环机制既确保了世界符合用户的意图，又使智能体的世界状态在整个探索过程中与生成内容保持一致。我们围绕共享的空间记忆以及度量相机轨迹和结构化提示的接口，对这两个层次进行了协同设计。在AgiWorld-WM中，为处理长时间展开过程中空间记忆中的遮挡问题和累积几何误差，我们提出了基于遮挡感知的历史选择方法，通过表面可见性检索过去的视角，以及基于可靠性的记忆维护策略，优先采用可靠的几何信息和较早的观测数据。AgiWorld-WM在世界重访和探索基准测试中实现了最先进的整体性能，定性和消融实验结果均表明，AgiWorld能够从自由形式的指令出发，在超过一分钟的旅程中构建持久的世界。因此，持续性并非仅源自视频模型本身，而是源于其与智能体形成的闭环机制。

title: CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.
tldr: This paper presents the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of class-incremental 3D object detection for autonomous driving, introducing CL3DOD, a framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting via teacher-student distillation and EMA-based consistency regularization, demonstrating consistent stability-plasticity trade-offs on KITTI and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: 本文首次在多个自动驾驶基准上对室外三维目标检测的类增量学习进行统一跨基准分析，提出CL3DOD框架，通过师生蒸馏和EMA一致性正则缓解灾难性遗忘，并在KITTI和nuScenes上验证了其稳定性-可塑性平衡优势。
summary_zh: 针对户外三维目标检测的类增量学习研究仍 largely 未被充分探索。现有户外研究仅限于单一基准评估，其中SDCoT++考虑KITTI，而CL2OD在nuScenes上采用不同的增量设置。这使得评估所观察到的持续学习行为能否在多个自动驾驶基准间泛化变得困难。据我们所知，我们首次提供了跨多个自动驾驶基准的户外类增量三维目标检测统一跨基准分析，涵盖双任务和多阶段设置。我们研究了：(1)现有三维检测器对先前学习类别的遗忘严重程度；(2)增量训练如何暴露知识保留与新类别获取之间的稳定性-可塑性困境；(3)哪种监督形式在平衡这些目标时最为有效。我们提出了CL3DOD，一种类增量三维检测框架，该框架利用前一阶段检测器的预测来恢复先前类别缺失的监督，通过查询级知识蒸馏保留旧类响应，并采用基于EMA的时间一致性正则化。在KITTI和nuScenes上的实验揭示了两个基准间一致的稳定性-可塑性困境。相较于受控增量基线，CL3DOD通常实现更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，并在已发表的基准比较中优于先前方法。该优势在多个增量阶段中持续存在，展示了在保持有效新类别获取的同时对先前学习知识的强大保留能力。我们的代码、评估设置和增量任务划分将公开发布。

title: MirrorComm: A Communication-Efficient Cooperative Perception Framework via Mirrored World Models
summary: Cooperative perception (CP) requires substantial communication bandwidth to exchange sensing information among connected agents. A variety of compression techniques have been proposed to reduce transmission costs while retaining task-relevant information. However, most existing methods follow a frame-wise compression paradigm, overlooking temporal predictability and repeatedly transmitting information that could be inferred from historical context. To address these limitations, we propose MirrorComm, the first world model-based communication-efficient CP framework. Specifically, mirrored world models at the transmitter and receiver predict the transmitter's current observation from a shared history of its reconstructed observations. The transmitter compares this prediction with its current observation and selectively transmits observation updates to correct prediction errors, reducing repeated transmission of predictable information. Experiments on the OPV2V dataset across two downstream tasks including object detection and semantic segmentation show that MirrorComm reduces communication bandwidth requirements by up to approximately 66-fold while maintaining comparable performance to a state-of-the-art (SOTA) method. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the individual components.
tldr: MirrorComm is a world model-based cooperative perception framework that transmits only prediction errors between agents, reducing communication bandwidth by up to ~66x on OPV2V while preserving detection and segmentation performance.
tldr_zh: MirrorComm 是一个基于世界模型的协同感知框架，通过仅传输预测误差，在OPV2V数据集上实现约66倍带宽压缩，同时保持检测和分割性能。
summary_zh: 协同感知（CP）需要在互联智能体之间交换感知信息，这要求大量的通信带宽。为降低传输开销同时保留任务相关信息，已有多种压缩方法被提出。然而，大多数现有方法遵循逐帧压缩范式，忽略了时间可预测性，并重复传输可由历史上下文推断的信息。为解决这些局限，我们提出了MirrorComm，这是首个基于世界模型的通信高效协同感知框架。具体而言，发射端和接收端的镜像世界模型根据共享的重建观测历史预测发射端的当前观测。发射端将该预测与其当前观测进行比较，并选择性地传输观测更新以纠正预测误差，从而减少可预测信息的重复传输。在OPV2V数据集上针对目标检测和语义分割两项下游任务的实验表明，MirrorComm将通信带宽需求最多降低约66倍，同时保持与最先进（SOTA）方法相当的性能。消融实验进一步证明了各组成部分的有效性。

title: Delay-Certified Readiness Barriers for Overactuated Multirotor Allocation Without Lipschitz Constants
summary: Overactuated multirotors can produce the same wrench with many rotor-speed combinations, some of which leave the vehicle unable to change its wrench quickly, e.g., to reject a gust. Readiness barriers keep this ability, the readiness, above a floor, but only in continuous time; with sampled commands and varying speed-controller delays, the available robustness bound covers less than one millisecond. We remove this limit by exploiting the structure of the problem: each rotor responds monotonically and in closed form to its own torque, so the speeds reachable under uncertain switching times lie in a cheaply computed box, and the lowest readiness over that box sits at a corner known in advance. This yields a Lipschitz-free test that a command keeps the readiness above its floor until the next sample, plus a fallback torque that keeps the vehicle on a certified plan. In hexarotor simulations with 2--40~ms delays and $\pm2$~ms jitter, the filter never violated the floor. At $10\pm2$~ms, it matched a delay-compensating predictor within the design envelope and cost 2--30\% more tracking error beyond it, where the predictor alone violated the floor in 2 to 16 of 16 missions.
tldr: This paper presents a delay-certified readiness barrier filter for overactuated multirotors that guarantees a minimum wrench-change readiness under sampled commands and variable speed-controller delays, using a Lipschitz-free corner test based on monotonic closed-form rotor responses and a certified fallback torque.
tldr_zh: 本文针对过驱动多旋翼，提出一种延迟认证的就绪度屏障滤波器，利用单调闭式转子响应和角点测试，在采样指令和可变速度控制器延迟下保证最小力矩变化就绪度，并提供认证的备份力矩。
summary_zh: 过驱动多旋翼能够通过多种旋翼转速组合产生相同的力旋量，其中部分组合会使飞行器无法快速改变其力旋量，例如抵抗阵风时所需的快速响应。就绪度屏障可将该能力（即就绪度）维持在预设下限之上，但仅限于连续时间；在采样指令和变化的速度控制器延迟条件下，可用的鲁棒性界覆盖范围不足一毫秒。我们通过利用该问题的结构特性来消除此限制：每个旋翼对其自身扭矩呈单调且闭式响应，因此在不确定切换时间下可达到的转速集合位于一个计算成本低廉的箱体内，而该箱体内就绪度的最小值位于预先已知的角点。由此，我们得到一个无需利普希茨条件的检验方法，可确保指令在下一个采样时刻之前使就绪度保持在下限之上，同时提供备用扭矩，使飞行器维持经认证的计划轨迹。在六旋翼仿真中，当延迟为2–40毫秒、抖动为±2毫秒时，该滤波器从未违反就绪度下限。在10±2毫秒条件下，其在设计包线内与延迟补偿预测器性能相当，超出包线后跟踪误差增加2–30%，而此时单独使用预测器在16次任务中有2至16次违反了就绪度下限。

title: Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum
summary: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.
tldr: This in-vitro user study introduces Copilot Assistance Modes for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation, showing that shared-autonomy modes achieve 92-97% success versus 23% for full autonomy, mitigating sim-to-real domain shift in mechanical thrombectomy.
tldr_zh: 这项体外用户研究提出了用于机器人血管内导航的Copilot辅助模式，实现临床医生与AI的协作，结果显示共享自主模式成功率达92-97%，而完全自主仅23%，有效缓解了机械取栓中的仿真到现实差距。
summary_zh: 机械取栓（MT）是急性缺血性卒中的有效治疗方法，但其可及性仍受限于神经介入专业人员的可用性。远程机器人和人工智能辅助系统可能有助于应对这一挑战，但目前尚不清楚临床医生如何与不同级别的自主性进行交互，以及自主导航系统在真实环境中的表现如何。本研究引入了副驾驶辅助模式（CAMs），这是一个用于机器人血管内导航中临床医生与人工智能协作的框架，涵盖从手动操作到完全自主的自主性谱系。在首个比较临床医生与人工智能协作策略的体外用户研究中，11名专家和两名学生在患者特异性血管体模中评估了六种导航模式。客观性能指标与主观评估相结合，包括工作负荷和可用性。此外，还在计算机模拟和体外环境中对自主性能进行了评估，以研究仿真到现实的迁移。手动直接导航取得了最强的整体性能（100%成功率）。虽然完全自主导航在仿真中达到了81%的成功率，但在体外环境中性能下降至23%。相比之下，几种临床医生与人工智能共享自主模式达到了92-97%的成功率，约为完全自主的四倍，并与直接机器人控制（95%）相当，表明临床医生与人工智能协作可以缓解仿真到现实的域偏移。在所评估的人工智能驱动方法中，用户导向的任务委托和旋转共享控制表现出性能与临床医生接受度之间最有利的平衡。这些发现表明，对于可靠的机器人神经介入导航而言，有效的临床医生与人工智能协作以及控制权限的分配目前可能比单纯提高自主性更为重要。

title: Toward Uncertainty-Aware, Physics-Grounded Human World Models
summary: A robot that acts around people needs a world model of the human: a belief over the person's body state and a dynamics model that predicts where that state goes next. This abstract argues that two published components form exactly these two halves, and specifies how to couple them. KNOWN [1] reconstructs the 3D human body while estimating both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in real time (11.6 ms per frame); its aleatoric term identifies unreliable observations, its epistemic term identifies inputs from low-density regions of the training data, and refinement driven by the epistemic term reduces the error on such inputs from 81.3 to 70.3 mm. PhysMoP [2] predicts future body configuration by solving the Euler-Lagrange equations of the body with learned dynamics terms, reducing the 80 ms prediction error from 9.6 to 2.1 mm on Human3.6M and from 12.1 to 0.7 mm on 3DPW. We define the interface between the two, propose three mechanisms by which KNOWN's uncertainty enters PhysMoP, and specify an evaluation protocol on in-the-wild video. No new experimental results are reported here.
tldr: This paper proposes coupling a real-time 3D human body reconstruction method with uncertainty estimation (KNOWN) and a physics-grounded human motion prediction model (PhysMoP) to form a human world model for robots acting around people, defining the interface and evaluation protocol without new experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将实时3D人体重建与不确定性估计方法（KNOWN）和基于物理的人体运动预测模型（PhysMoP）耦合，形成面向机器人的人体世界模型，定义了接口和评估协议，但未报告新实验结果。
summary_zh: 面向在与人类共处环境中行动的机器人，需要建立关于人的世界模型：一个关于人体状态的信念，以及一个预测该状态下一步走向的动力学模型。本摘要论证，两项已发表组件恰好构成这两半，并说明如何将它们耦合起来。KNOWN [1] 在重建三维人体的同时实时估计偶然不确定性和认知不确定性（每帧11.6 ms）；其偶然项识别不可靠观测，其认知项识别来自训练数据低密度区域的输入，而由认知项驱动的细化将此类输入上的误差从81.3 mm降至70.3 mm。PhysMoP [2] 通过求解带有学习动力学项的人体欧拉-拉格朗日方程来预测未来身体构型，在Human3.6M上将80 ms预测误差从9.6 mm降至2.1 mm，在3DPW上从12.1 mm降至0.7 mm。我们定义二者之间的接口，提出KNOWN的不确定性进入PhysMoP的三种机制，并指定一套在野外视频上的评估协议。本文不报告新的实验结果。

title: Towards end-to-end co-design for one-shot printable task-specific soft robots
summary: Soft robot co-design methods can jointly optimise morphology and control, but the resulting designs are often difficult to manufacture, while manufacturable approaches typically restrict actuator placement or require manual assembly. We present a simulation-based co-design framework that jointly optimises material distribution, pneumatic actuator placement and orientation, and control, while producing designs that can be fabricated monolithically using fused deposition modelling. The framework uses a differentiable 2D plane-stress Material Point Method simulator, incorporating an experimentally validated material model and an empirically derived surrogate model of a 3D-printed inflatable actuator. We demonstrate gradient-based optimisation soft robotic arms for prescribed tip trajectories. Optimised designs are transferred directly from simulation to one-shot monolithic FDM fabrication, with integrated actuators and no post-assembly. Physical experiments demonstrate that the resulting arms reproduce the behaviour predicted in simulation. This framework provides a path from task-level objectives to physically realisable soft robots while retaining substantial freedom over both morphology and actuation.
tldr: This paper presents a simulation-based co-design framework that jointly optimizes material distribution, pneumatic actuator placement/orientation, and control for soft robots, producing designs that can be monolithically fabricated via FDM and validated in physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的协同设计框架，联合优化软体机器人的材料分布、气动执行器布局与朝向及控制策略，使设计可通过FDM一体化制造，并通过物理实验验证了仿真预测的行为。
summary_zh: 软体机器人协同设计方法能够联合优化形态与控制，但由此产生的设计往往难以制造，而可制造的方法通常限制执行器的布置或需要手动组装。我们提出了一种基于仿真的协同设计框架，该框架联合优化材料分布、气动执行器的位置与方向以及控制，同时生成可通过熔融沉积建模进行整体制造的设计。该框架采用可微分的二维平面应力物质点法模拟器，结合了经实验验证的材料模型以及基于经验推导的三维打印充气执行器代理模型。我们展示了针对指定末端轨迹的基于梯度的软体机械臂优化。优化后的设计可直接从仿真转移至一次性整体式FDM制造，集成执行器且无需后续组装。物理实验表明，所得机械臂能够重现仿真中预测的行为。该框架提供了一条从任务级目标到物理可实现软体机器人的路径，同时在形态和驱动方面保留了充分的自由度。

title: Closing the Dynamics Gap through Self-Directed Robotic Interaction
summary: Agentic Real2Sim2Real systems can reconstruct a scene in simulation from camera observations, but contact-rich dynamics such as friction and restitution cannot be observed without interaction. We call this the dynamics gap and present CUE, an agentic system that closes it by interacting with the environment itself. Given only a high-level instruction and no resets, the agent builds its own perception, identifies physical parameters, and targets interactions where its simulation is least accurate. On billiards, CUE reduces held-out ball-position error by 72% relative to the strongest baseline across 25 hidden-physics conditions in simulation, and we further deploy it on a real pool table. More details can be found on the project website: https://cue-dynamics.github.io/
tldr: CUE is an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that autonomously interacts with its environment to identify and correct unknown physical dynamics (e.g., friction, restitution) in simulation, reducing held-out position error by 72% in billiards and demonstrating real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: CUE 是一个智能体式 Real2Sim2Real 系统，通过自主与环境交互来识别并修正仿真中未知的物理动态（如摩擦、恢复系数），在台球任务中将留出位置误差降低 72%，并已在实际场景中部署。
summary_zh: 智能体式真实到仿真再回到真实（Agentic Real2Sim2Real）系统能够从相机观测中在仿真环境中重建场景，但诸如摩擦和恢复系数等接触丰富的动力学特性无法仅通过观测获得。我们将这一现象称为动力学差距（dynamics gap），并提出了CUE，一种通过与环境自身交互来弥合该差距的智能体系统。该系统仅需一条高层指令且无需重置，便能自主构建感知、识别物理参数，并针对仿真中最不准确的交互进行定向优化。在台球场景下，CUE在25种隐藏物理条件下的仿真中，相较于最强基线，将留出法（held-out）球位置误差降低了72%；此外，我们还在真实台球桌上对其进行了部署验证。更多细节请参见项目网站：https://cue-dynamics.github.io/

title: A Study on the Effects of Finger Movements on a Humanoid Hugging Robot
summary: This study aimed to examine the impact of finger movements in hugging robots on users by experimentally investigating how the presence and patterns of such movements affect users psychologically. The results suggest that the presence and patterns of finger movements influence the sensations users seek from the robot; specifically, repetitive movements and asynchronous movements across multiple fingers tended to enhance these sensations. Additionally, simultaneous movement of all fingers and gentle hugging tended to evoke a greater sense of care. Conversely, no differences were observed regarding resistance to physical contact initiated by the robot.
tldr: This paper experimentally investigates how finger movements in a humanoid hugging robot affect users' psychological perception, finding that repetitive and asynchronous finger movements enhance certain sensations while simultaneous movement and gentle hugging evoke a greater sense of care.
tldr_zh: 本文通过实验研究人形拥抱机器人手指运动对用户心理感知的影响，发现重复和异步的手指运动可增强某些感受，而所有手指同步运动和轻柔拥抱则唤起更强的关怀感。
summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过实验探究拥抱机器人中手指动作的存在及其模式如何影响用户心理，从而考察这些动作对用户的影响。结果表明，手指动作的存在及其模式会影响用户从机器人身上寻求的感觉；具体而言，重复性动作和多指异步动作倾向于增强这些感觉。此外，所有手指的同时动作和轻柔的拥抱更易引发被关怀的感觉。相反，在机器人主动发起的身体接触的抗拒程度方面，未观察到显著差异。

title: Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift
summary: RL locomotion policies trained under nominal simulation conditions may encounter distribution shifts that compromise safety. Predictive monitors could anticipate violations, but their world-model forecasts may become unreliable under shift, and ensemble disagreement is not calibrated. We evaluate predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for frozen Ant-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5 policies using closed-loop world-model rollouts and a three-model ensemble. Across external-force, observation-noise, and mass shifts, predicted robustness ranks HalfCheetah's future STL violations strongly, whereas disagreement does not reliably track observation prediction error or violations. Under severe noise, violations remain common ($64.2\pm24.4\%$ at $K{=}20$ across three PPO seeds), yet current-state robustness without prediction comes within $0.03$ AUROC of predictive robustness. Penalizing predicted robustness by disagreement does not consistently improve ranking. Ant provides complementary per-specification evidence, but its composite target has no positive violations and its any-violation target is single-class in most evaluated seed-condition slices. Overall, predictive robustness provides useful STL-specific ranking but little demonstrated additional ranking value over the current state; these findings caution against treating ensemble disagreement as a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
tldr: This paper evaluates predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for RL locomotion policies under distribution shift, finding that predicted robustness ranks violations well but adds little value over current-state robustness, and that ensemble disagreement is not a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了分布偏移下RL运动策略的预测性信号时序逻辑（STL）监控，发现预测鲁棒性对违规排序有效，但相比当前状态鲁棒性几乎没有额外价值，且集成分歧不能可靠指示安全不确定性。
summary_zh: 基于标称仿真条件训练的强化学习运动策略，在部署中可能遭遇分布偏移，从而危及安全性。预测性监控器可用于预判违规行为，但其世界模型在外推场景下的预测可能不可靠，且集成模型之间的分歧缺乏校准。本文针对冻结的Ant-v5和HalfCheetah-v5策略，采用闭环世界模型轨迹滚动及三模型集成方法，评估了预测性信号时序逻辑（STL）监控的有效性。在外部力、观测噪声及质量偏移场景下，预测鲁棒性能够强有力地排序HalfCheetah未来的STL违规情况，而模型分歧则无法可靠地跟踪观测预测误差或违规行为。在强噪声条件下，违规行为依然频发（三个PPO种子在$K{=}20$时违规率为$64.2\pm24.4\%$），然而，不依赖预测的当前状态鲁棒性在AUROC上与预测鲁棒性相差仅$0.03$。通过引入模型分歧对预测鲁棒性进行惩罚，并未能持续提升排序效果。Ant在逐规格层面提供了补充证据，但其复合目标未出现正向违规行为，且其“任何违规”目标在多数评估的种子-条件切片中呈现单一类别。总体而言，预测鲁棒性提供了有价值的STL特定排序能力，但相较于当前状态并未展现出显著的额外排序价值；上述发现提醒我们，不应将集成模型分歧视为安全不确定性的可靠指标。

title: History-Aware Force Sensing and Tunable Stiffness in a Pneumatic Kresling Origami Cell
summary: Mechanical hysteresis and pneumatic loading complicate contact force estimation from deformation measurements in soft robots. This work presents a 3D-printed polyether block amide (PEBA) Kresling cell with magnetic angular sensing that supports three operating modes: force sensing at zero gauge pressure, force sensing with tunable stiffness under gauge positive pressure, and self-sensing actuation under negative gauge pressure. A multiscale gated recurrent unit (GRU) network estimates contact force from angular histories to account for the the combined effects of geometric deformation and material response. At zero gauge pressure, the model achieves a test RMSE of 0.76~N. Positive gauge pressure approximately doubles the average axial loading stiffness at +20~kPa over the first 3~mm of compression, while pressure-specific models maintain RMSEs below 0.93~N. Under negative gauge pressure, an energy-based compensation model enables contact force estimation using the the model trained at zero gauge pressure, achieving RMSEs of 1.66--2.10~N under quasi-static conditions. These results demonstrate a compact approach to combining force feedback, tunable axial stiffness, and self-sensing actuation in soft origami systems.
tldr: A 3D-printed PEBA Kresling origami cell with magnetic angular sensing and a multiscale GRU estimates contact force under zero, positive, and negative gauge pressures, enabling tunable stiffness and self-sensing actuation.
tldr_zh: 一种3D打印的PEBA Kresling折纸单元，利用磁角度传感和多尺度GRU网络，在零压、正压和负压下估计接触力，实现可调刚度和自感知驱动。
summary_zh: 机械迟滞和气动加载使得基于变形测量的软体机器人接触力估计变得复杂。本研究提出了一种带有磁角传感器的三维打印聚醚嵌段酰胺（PEBA）Kresling折纸单元，其支持三种工作模式：零表压下的力传感、正表压下刚度可调的力传感，以及负表压下的自传感驱动。为综合考虑几何变形与材料响应的耦合效应，采用多尺度门控循环单元（GRU）网络从角度历史数据中估计接触力。在零表压条件下，模型测试均方根误差（RMSE）为0.76 N。在+20 kPa正表压下，前3 mm压缩行程内平均轴向加载刚度约提升一倍，而针对特定压力的模型RMSE保持在0.93 N以下。在负表压下，基于能量的补偿模型可利用零表压条件下训练的模型实现接触力估计，在准静态条件下RMSE为1.66～2.10 N。上述结果表明，该研究为软体折纸系统提供了一种集力反馈、可调轴向刚度与自传感驱动于一体的紧凑方案。

title: Predictive Safety Guardrails Do Not Always Make LLM Agents Safer
summary: Large language model agents increasingly take consequential actions in digital and physical environments, where safety risks may emerge only after multiple interaction steps. This has motivated world-model-driven predictive safety guardrails, which anticipate future consequences before execution. However, existing evaluations largely focus on end-to-end safety outcomes, leaving unclear whether safety gains arise from reliable prediction and faithful use of predicted risks. In this work, we systematically diagnose the prediction-to-action pipeline along three dimensions: how world-model predictions are integrated into decision making, whether the predictions themselves are reliable, and whether their content is faithfully used. Across seven policy models and two safety environments, we find that stronger prediction involvement does not yield monotonic safety gains and can reduce task completion while substantially increasing inference cost. We further find that world-model predictions remain insufficiently reliable, especially over longer horizons, where safety prediction degrades substantially relative to near-term forecasting. Finally, we find that safety gains can persist even under corrupted predictions, while locally verified predictions still leave subsequent safety violations, showing that predictive content is not faithfully incorporated into the decision process. Together, these findings expose a fundamental prediction-to-action gap in current predictive guardrails: producing more or seemingly accurate foresight is insufficient unless that foresight is both reliable and faithfully translated into safer decisions.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates predictive safety guardrails for LLM agents, revealing a prediction-to-action gap where stronger prediction integration does not reliably improve safety, predictions degrade over long horizons, and safety gains persist under corrupted predictions, indicating unreliable and unfaithful use of foresight.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了LLM代理的预测性安全护栏，揭示了预测到行动之间的差距：更强的预测整合并不能可靠提升安全性，长周期预测性能下降，且即使在预测被破坏时安全收益仍存在，表明预测内容不可靠且未被忠实利用。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地在数字和物理环境中采取具有重大后果的行动，而安全风险往往只有在多个交互步骤之后才会显现。这推动了基于世界模型的预测性安全护栏的发展，该类护栏在执行前预判未来后果。然而，现有评估主要聚焦于端到端的安全结果，尚不清楚安全收益是否源于可靠的预测以及对预测风险的忠实利用。在本研究中，我们沿三个维度系统性地诊断从预测到行动的管线：世界模型预测如何整合进决策过程、预测本身是否可靠，以及预测内容是否被忠实使用。基于七个策略模型和两个安全环境，我们发现，更强的预测参与并不会带来单调递增的安全收益，反而可能降低任务完成率，同时显著增加推理成本。我们还发现，世界模型预测的可靠性仍显不足，尤其在较长预测视野下，安全预测相较短期预测显著退化。最后，我们发现，即便在预测被破坏的情况下，安全收益仍可能持续存在，而局部验证通过的预测仍会留下后续的安全违规，这表明预测内容并未被忠实纳入决策过程。以上发现共同揭示了当前预测性安全护栏中一个根本性的“预测—行动”鸿沟：除非预测既可靠又能被忠实地转化为更安全的决策，否则产生更多或看似更准确的预见并不足以带来安全保障。

title: HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events
summary: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.
tldr: This paper proposes HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that reconstructs high frame rate HDR videos from a single LDR frame and events, targeting autonomous driving applications. It uses teacher-student distillation to adapt from synthetic to real data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HIVE-Diff，一种事件条件视频扩散框架，从单个LDR帧和事件重建高帧率HDR视频，面向自动驾驶应用，并通过教师-学生蒸馏实现从合成数据到真实数据的适应。
summary_zh: 高帧率HDR视频在自动驾驶和科学成像等应用中具有重要意义，这些场景中快速运动与极端光照条件往往同时存在。传统帧相机面临时间分辨率与动态范围之间的权衡，而事件相机则能在宽光照范围内提供互补的高速亮度变化测量。这些特性催生了基于事件相机的HDR重建研究，现有方法主要分为纯事件范式与事件-帧混合范式两类。然而，纯事件HDR重建由于缺乏绝对强度参考，容易出现亮度和色彩漂移问题。事件-帧混合方法通过引入低动态范围（LDR）帧作为锚点来缓解这一不确定性，但大多数方法仅在现有LDR时间戳处进行一对一HDR重建。在本研究中，我们探索了单参考HDR时间扩展方法，即利用一个LDR参考帧和事件数据重建N个HDR帧，而无需N个对齐的LDR观测。我们提出了HIVEDiff，一种事件条件视频扩散框架，将任务分解为事件引导的时间生成和HDR内容补全两个子任务。由于配对的真实HDR事件数据稀缺，我们在合成数据上训练模型，并通过教师-学生蒸馏方式，利用LDR-事件序列作为代理监督，将模型适应到真实事件域。在合成数据集和多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法具有出色的重建质量和稳健的真实数据适应能力。

title: OpenZilo: An Open Smart-Ring Platform for Human-Centric Sensing and Interaction with Robots
summary: Wearable robot interfaces must connect user input to timely physical action. We present the proposed platform, an open smart-ring platform for studying this connection across task stages. The ring integrates a microphone, an inertial measurement unit, photoplethysmography, and skin-temperature sensing. Its software architecture separates acquisition, event interpretation, interaction policy, and robot execution. We characterize seven operating modes and evaluate speech and gesture control with 10 participants. Across five commands and 250 trials per modality, speech and gestures achieved task success rates of 90.4% and 88.8%, respectively. Recognition accuracy exceeded task success for both modalities. Gaussian hidden Markov models achieved higher accuracy than a support vector machine across three vocabulary sizes, with longer scoring times. Following a shared spoken task start, gesture-based adjustments had shorter median response times than speech. Whole-task success was 70.0% with gestures and 64.0% with speech. We further examine physiological-event-triggered robot interaction using simulated event notifications. Mean notification-receipt-to-arrival times were 11.71 s for the robot and 9.20 s for an on-site person. These descriptive findings support evaluating wearable robot interfaces through both recognition and physical outcomes, with timing measures appropriate to each task stage.
tldr: OpenZilo is an open smart-ring platform integrating microphone, IMU, PPG, and skin-temperature sensing to enable human-centric sensing and interaction with robots, evaluated on speech and gesture control and physiological-event-triggered interaction.
tldr_zh: OpenZilo 是一个开源智能戒指平台，集成麦克风、IMU、PPG 和皮温传感，用于以人为中心的机器人感知与交互，并评估了语音、手势控制及生理事件触发的交互。

title: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
summary: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
tldr: MISLAM is a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial SLAM system using an IMU and nine-magnetometer array for field robot localization under GNSS denial and degraded visual conditions, achieving 45.7%-78.0% endpoint closure error reductions versus magnetic-inertial odometry.
tldr_zh: MISLAM是一种紧耦合的磁惯性SLAM系统，使用IMU和九磁力计阵列，在GNSS拒止和视觉退化条件下为野外机器人提供定位，相比磁惯性里程计将端点闭合误差降低45.7%-78.0%。

title: To Coordinate or Not to Coordinate? Learning to Swim with Eight Soft Arms
summary: Does effective swimming with multiple underactuated soft arms require explicit coordination between arms? We hypothesize that an eight-arm swimmer can control its swimming speed and direction by independently learning each arm's actuation amplitude under a shared rhythmic drive, without prescribed inter-arm phase coupling. To test this hypothesis, we compare three reinforcement learning-based control strategies using proximal policy optimization (PPO): (1) learning arm-specific actuation amplitudes without inter-arm phase coupling, (2) learning actuation amplitudes with prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, and (3) directly learning actuator commands through end-to-end PPO without an explicit rhythmic structure. Across 200 episodes with randomized three-dimensional velocity commands, the controller without phase coupling satisfies the tracking criterion in 169 episodes, compared with 117 for the phase-coupled controller and 28 for end-to-end PPO. Straight-line swimming and commanded direction-change trials further demonstrate more accurate velocity tracking without phase coupling. These findings suggest that effective eight-arm swimming does not require prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, but can instead be achieved through learned arm-specific amplitude modulation within a rhythmic control structure.
tldr: This paper compares three PPO-based control strategies for an eight-arm soft swimmer, finding that learning arm-specific actuation amplitudes under a shared rhythmic drive without explicit inter-arm phase coupling yields the best velocity tracking performance.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了八臂软体游泳机器人的三种PPO控制策略，发现在共享节律驱动下独立学习各臂驱动幅度而无需显式臂间相位耦合，能获得最佳的游动速度跟踪性能。

title: Late Autumn: LLM Agents Specialize a General Multi-Robot Planner for One Warehouse
summary: No algorithm is best on all problems, but a real warehouse is a narrow problem: its layout and processes rarely change. Operators still run one general multi-robot planner at many sites, because experts cannot tune it for each one. In this work, which we call Late Autumn, we explore whether LLM coding agents running autonomous research can specialize a general planner for one site, trading generality for throughput, much as post-training adapts a pretrained LLM to one task. We study six campaigns on a lifelong planner that combines task assignment with multi-agent path finding, on a floor modeled on an existing automated warehouse. We find that (1) the agents raise throughput by 22--60%, and the gains hold on unseen seeds; (2) they rediscover known MAPF mechanisms, such as corridor-exit priorities, local guidance, and rollouts, and independent campaigns find the same bottleneck; (3) the gains largely carry over to another layout, a larger fleet, and other service times, shrink with a smaller fleet, and mostly vanish under an outbound-heavy demand mix; and (4) each final patch (0.7k--2.4k lines) is a chain of scored commits with a median step of 27 lines, so experts can review it, and review finds problems that the score misses; some patches multiply planner compute by over 100x. LLM agents can therefore turn each site's bias into extra throughput at little engineering cost, with reviewable patches; we expect experts to shift toward designing insightful metrics and fast simulators that mirror the real problem.
tldr: LLM coding agents autonomously specialize a general multi-robot warehouse planner for a single site, raising throughput 22-60% via reviewable patch chains that rediscover known MAPF mechanisms.
tldr_zh: LLM编码智能体自主地将通用多机器人仓库规划器针对单一场地专门化，通过可审查的补丁链使吞吐量提升22-60%，并重新发现已知的MAPF机制。

title: Myoelectric Control for Upper-Limb Exoskeletons: A Decoder-Shaper-Controller Framework, Design Guidelines, and Future Directions
summary: Myoelectric Control Systems (MCSs) enable voluntary control of wearable robots through muscle activity. However, intention decoding, assistance shaping, and low-level actuator control are often not explicitly distinguished, making their contributions difficult to evaluate and compare. This review introduces a functional decoder-shaper-controller framework for continuous myoelectric control of upper-limb exoskeletons. The decoder estimates an intention-related variable from surface electromyography (sEMG), the shaper maps it to a control reference according to an assistance policy, and the controller realizes that reference through actuator control. This decomposition separates intention estimation from assistance-policy design and enables comparison of heterogeneous architectures. Representative approaches are critically examined in terms of module design, calibration, and evaluation. The analysis highlights that the shaper, despite determining the magnitude and shape of assistance, lacks established design and tuning methodologies and is often embedded within the decoder or controller. Key open issues include inconsistent reporting of assistance levels, limited use of interaction-aware stability and passivity tools, and insufficient validation across degrees of freedom, users, and tasks. Building on these findings, this review provides design guidelines for systematic module-wise tuning and identifies future research priorities to bridge the gap between accurate intention decoding and safe, effective, and generalizable assistance under real-world operating conditions.
tldr: This review introduces a decoder-shaper-controller framework for decomposing continuous myoelectric control of upper-limb exoskeletons, critically examining module designs and providing design guidelines for systematic tuning.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述提出了一个用于上肢外骨骼连续肌电控制的解码器-整形器-控制器框架，批判性地审视了模块设计，并为系统化调优提供了设计指南。

title: TRAILS: Trajectory Generation for Automated Indoor Locomotion Studies
summary: Virtual reality experiments involving navigation and simulated robot motion often require large, realistic environments and numerous distinct trajectories to avoid repetitive navigation while providing sufficient variation for controlled experiments. Designing such scenarios manually is labor-intensive, particularly when trajectories must satisfy predefined geometric and kinematic constraints while remaining diverse and comparable across experimental conditions. This paper presents TRAILS, an automated framework for generating complete virtual navigation scenarios consisting of an environment layout, a path, and a time-parameterized motion profile. The framework combines a constraint-based procedural environment generator inspired by Wave Function Collapse, trajectory generation using optimized cubic Bézier curves, and speed-profile generation subject to kinematic constraints. The generated scenarios provide diverse indoor environments with corridors, open spaces, and obstacles, together with trajectories of identical duration that vary in path geometry, wall proximity, and velocity profiles while minimizing systematic dependencies between these characteristics. The framework is designed as an easy-to-use tool requiring only a small number of intuitive user-defined parameters to automatically generate large sets of distinct navigation scenarios satisfying prescribed geometric and kinematic constraints. By relying on explicit, seed-controlled algorithmic procedures rather than data-driven models, the generated scenarios remain transparent, reproducible, and configurable, making the framework well suited for telepresence and human-subject experiments. The code is available at https://github.com/JucciK/Trails .
tldr: TRAILS is a procedural framework that automatically generates complete VR navigation scenarios—environment layouts via Wave Function Collapse and constraint-optimized cubic Bézier trajectories with kinematic speed profiles—for controlled indoor locomotion and telepresence experiments.
tldr_zh: TRAILS 是一个程序化框架，通过波函数坍缩生成环境布局，并用基于优化的三次贝塞尔曲线和运动学速度剖面生成完整轨迹，用于受控的室内导航与远程临场实验。

title: Swarm Choreography Made Simple: Superposed Guiding Vector Fields for Rigid Formation Path Following
summary: This paper presents a decentralized guiding vector field framework for rigid formation path following in multi- UAV systems based on the superposition of simple rule-driven vector fields. Each control objective is encoded as a dedicated vector-field component: a normalized tangential term to ensure progression along a prescribed geometric path at a desired speed, a convergence term driving the formation toward the path, a local coordination term that preserves the desired formation shape through a pseudo-path parameter, and a local separation term for inter-agent collision avoidance. The coordination mechanism requires the exchange of only a single scalar per agent, resulting in low communication bandwidth.
